nodes.desc_en: North London's "Bees" from The Hive — founded in 1888, won the National League in 2024/25 to return to the Football League.

nodes.name: Bristol Rovers
nodes.desc: „Piráti" z Memorial Stadium, druhý bristolský klub
nodes.desc_en: The "Pirates" from the Memorial Stadium, Bristol's second club

nodes.name: Cheltenham Town
nodes.desc: „Robins“ z dostihového mesta v Gloucestershire — klub založený 1887, do Football League vstúpil v roku 1999, v sezóne 2020/21 vyhral League Two.
nodes.desc_en: The "Robins" from the racing town in Gloucestershire — founded in 1887, joined the Football League in 1999 and won League Two in 2020/21.

nodes.name: Chesterfield
nodes.desc: „Spireites“ z Derbyshire, pomenovaní podľa krivej veže kostola — v sezóne 2023/24 vyhrali National League a po šiestich rokoch sa vrátili do Football League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Spireites" from Derbyshire, named after the town's Crooked Spire — won the National League in 2023/24 to return to the Football League after six years.

nodes.name: Colchester United
nodes.desc: „U's“ z Essexu, Community Stadium — klub založený 1937, v roku 1971 senzačne vyradil Leeds United 3:2 v 5. kole FA Cupu.
nodes.desc_en: The "U's" from Essex, the Community Stadium — founded in 1937, famously knocked out Leeds United 3–2 in the FA Cup fifth round in 1971.

nodes.name: Crawley Town
nodes.desc: „Červení diabli“ zo Sussexu — klub založený 1896, do Football League postúpil v roku 2011, v roku 2024 vyhral play-off League Two.
nodes.desc_en: The "Red Devils" from Sussex — founded in 1896, promoted to the Football League in 2011 and won the League Two play-offs in 2024.

nodes.name: Crewe Alexandra
nodes.desc: „Železničiari“ z Gresty Road preslávení výchovou mladých hráčov — klub založený 1877, v roku 2013 vyhral Football League Trophy.
nodes.desc_en: The "Railwaymen" from Gresty Road, renowned for developing young players — founded in 1877, won the Football League Trophy in 2013.

nodes.name: Exeter City
nodes.desc: Fanúšikmi vlastnený klub z Devonu, St James Park — trust fanúšikov ho väčšinovo vlastní od roku 2003, v sezóne 2025/26 zostúpil z League One.
nodes.desc_en: Fan-owned club from Devon, St James Park — the supporters' trust has held a majority stake since 2003; relegated from League One in 2025/26.

nodes.name: Fleetwood Town
nodes.desc: Klub z rybárskeho mesta v Lancashire, Highbury Stadium — súčasný klub vznikol v roku 1997, do Football League postúpil v roku 2012 ako víťaz Conference.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the fishing town in Lancashire, Highbury Stadium — the current club was formed in 1997 and reached the Football League as Conference champions in 2012.

nodes.name: Gillingham
nodes.desc: Klub z Kentu z Priestfield Stadium — založený v roku 1893 ako New Brompton, majster štvrtej ligy 1963/64 aj League Two 2012/13.
nodes.desc_en: Kent club from the Priestfield Stadium — founded in 1893 as New Brompton, fourth-tier champions in 1963/64 and League Two champions in 2012/13.

nodes.name: Grimsby Town
nodes.desc: „Mariners“ z Blundell Parku v Cleethorpes — klub založený 1878, v roku 2022 sa cez baráž vrátil do EFL.
nodes.desc_en: The "Mariners" from Blundell Park in Cleethorpes — founded in 1878, the club returned to the EFL via the play-offs in 2022.

nodes.name: Newport County
nodes.desc: Waleský klub z Rodney Parade známy pohárovými senzáciami — v FA Cupe vyradil Leeds (2018) aj Leicester (2019), v Pohári víťazov pohárov 1980/81 hral štvrťfinále.
nodes.desc_en: Welsh club from Rodney Parade known for cup shocks — knocked Leeds (2018) and Leicester (2019) out of the FA Cup and reached the 1980/81 Cup Winners' Cup quarter-finals.

nodes.name: Northampton Town
nodes.desc: „Cobblers“ (obuvníci) zo Sixfields — klub založený 1897, jedinú sezónu v najvyššej súťaži odohral 1965/66; v roku 2026 zostúpil z League One.
nodes.desc_en: The "Cobblers" from Sixfields — founded in 1897, the club spent its only top-flight season in 1965/66; relegated from League One in 2026.

nodes.name: Oldham Athletic
nodes.desc: Zakladajúci člen Premier League, návrat medzi profesionálov
nodes.desc_en: A founding member of the Premier League, back among the professional ranks

nodes.name: Port Vale
nodes.desc: Klub z Burslemu, večný rival Stoke City, Vale Park — dvakrát vyhral Football League Trophy (1993, 2001), v roku 2026 zostúpil z League One.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Burslem, Stoke City's perennial rivals, Vale Park — two-time Football League Trophy winners (1993, 2001), relegated from League One in 2026.

nodes.name: Rochdale
nodes.desc: „Dale“ zo Spotlandu vo Veľkom Manchestri — klub založený 1907, po zostupe v roku 2023 sa v roku 2026 cez baráž vrátil do EFL.
nodes.desc_en: "Dale" from Spotland in Greater Manchester — founded in 1907, the club returned to the EFL via the play-offs in 2026 after dropping out in 2023.

nodes.name: Rotherham United
nodes.desc: „Mlynári“ z New York Stadium (otvorený 2012) — dvakrát vyhrali EFL Trophy (1996, 2022), v roku 2026 zostúpili z League One.
nodes.desc_en: The "Millers" from the New York Stadium (opened 2012) — two-time EFL Trophy winners (1996, 2022), relegated from League One in 2026.

nodes.name: Salford City
nodes.desc: Klub vlastnený hviezdami „Class of 92" Manchestru United
nodes.desc_en: Club owned by Manchester United's "Class of 92"

nodes.name: Shrewsbury Town
nodes.desc: Klub zo Shropshire pri waleských hraniciach, New Meadow — založený 1886, majster tretej ligy 1978/79; z League One zostúpil v roku 2025.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Shropshire near the Welsh border, New Meadow — founded in 1886, third-tier champions in 1978/79; relegated from League One in 2025.

nodes.name: Swindon Town
nodes.desc: „Robins“ z Wiltshire, County Ground — klub založený 1879, v roku 1969 vyhral Ligový pohár nad Arsenalom 3:1 a v roku 1993 postúpil do Premier League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Robins" from Wiltshire, the County Ground — founded in 1879, beat Arsenal 3–1 to win the 1969 League Cup and reached the Premier League in 1993.

nodes.name: Tranmere Rovers
nodes.desc: Klub z Birkenheadu za riekou Mersey, Prenton Park — založený 1884, finalista Ligového pohára 2000, do Football League sa vrátil v roku 2018 cez baráž.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Birkenhead, across the river Mersey, Prenton Park — founded in 1884, League Cup finalists in 2000, back in the Football League via the 2018 play-offs.

nodes.name: Walsall
nodes.desc: „Sedlári“ z Bescot Stadium (od 1990) — klub založený 1888, v roku 1933 senzačne vyradil Arsenal z FA Cupu (2:0), majster League Two 2006/07.
nodes.desc_en: The "Saddlers" from the Bescot Stadium (since 1990) — founded in 1888, stunned Arsenal 2–0 in the 1933 FA Cup and won League Two in 2006/07.

nodes.name: York City
nodes.desc: Klub z historického Yorku, „Minstermen“ — založený 1922, v roku 2026 sa ako víťaz National League (108 bodov) vrátil po 10 rokoch do EFL.
nodes.desc_en: Club from historic York, the "Minstermen" — founded in 1922, returned to the EFL in 2026 as National League champions (108 points) after ten years away.

nodes.name: National League
nodes.desc: National League má 24 klubov — Yeovil Town, AFC Fylde, Aldershot Town a Altrincham. Piata anglická úroveň — najvyššia non-league súťaž, brána do EFL.
nodes.desc_en: National League has 24 clubs — Yeovil Town, AFC Fylde, Aldershot Town and Altrincham. Fifth English tier — the top non-league competition, gateway to the EFL.

nodes.name: AFC Fylde
nodes.desc: Ambiciózny klub z Lancashire, Mill Farm — v roku 2019 vyhral FA Trophy a v ročníku 2025/26 ovládol National League North.
nodes.desc_en: Ambitious club from Lancashire, Mill Farm — won the FA Trophy in 2019 and the 2025/26 National League North title.

nodes.name: Aldershot Town
nodes.desc: „The Shots“ z vojenského mesta v Hampshire — klub založený v roku 1992 vyhral v roku 2025 FA Trophy, vo finále zdolal Spennymoor 3:0.
nodes.desc_en: "The Shots" from the garrison town in Hampshire — founded in 1992, the club won the FA Trophy in 2025, beating Spennymoor 3–0 in the final.

nodes.name: Altrincham
nodes.desc: Tradičný non-league klub z Veľkého Manchestru (zal. 1891) — majster Alliance Premier League 1979/80 a 1980/81, víťaz FA Trophy 1978 a 1986.
nodes.desc_en: Traditional non-league club from Greater Manchester (founded 1891) — Alliance Premier League champions 1979/80 and 1980/81, FA Trophy winners 1978 and 1986.

nodes.name: Barrow
nodes.desc: „Bluebirds“ z Kumbrie, Holker Street — po šiestich sezónach v EFL (2020–2026) v roku 2026 zostúpili z League Two.
nodes.desc_en: The "Bluebirds" from Cumbria, Holker Street — relegated from League Two in 2026 after six seasons in the EFL (2020–2026).

nodes.name: Boreham Wood
nodes.desc: Klub z Hertfordshire pri filmových štúdiách Elstree
nodes.desc_en: Club from Hertfordshire, near the Elstree film studios

nodes.name: Boston United
nodes.desc: „Pilgrims“ z Lincolnshire — majster Conference 2001/02, potom v rokoch 2002–2007 hrali vo Football League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Pilgrims" from Lincolnshire — Conference champions in 2001/02, then played in the Football League from 2002 to 2007.

nodes.name: Carlisle United
nodes.desc: Klub z najsevernejšieho anglického mesta, Brunton Park
nodes.desc_en: Club from England's northernmost city, Brunton Park

nodes.name: Eastleigh
nodes.desc: „Spitfires“ z Hampshire — klub založený v roku 1946 ako Swaythling Athletic postúpil v roku 2014 do National League ako majster Conference South.
nodes.desc_en: The "Spitfires" from Hampshire — founded in 1946 as Swaythling Athletic, promoted to the National League in 2014 as Conference South champions.

nodes.name: FC Halifax Town
nodes.desc: Klub z The Shay v západnom Yorkshire, založený v roku 2008 — dvakrát vyhral FA Trophy, v rokoch 2016 a 2023.
nodes.desc_en: Club from The Shay in West Yorkshire, founded in 2008 — two-time FA Trophy winners, in 2016 and 2023.

nodes.name: Forest Green Rovers
nodes.desc: Najekologickejší klub sveta — vegánsky a uhlíkovo neutrálny
nodes.desc_en: The world's greenest club — vegan and carbon-neutral

nodes.name: Gateshead
nodes.desc: Klub od rieky Tyne, Gateshead International Stadium
nodes.desc_en: Club on the river Tyne, the Gateshead International Stadium

nodes.name: Harrogate Town
nodes.desc: „Sulphurites“ z kúpeľného mesta v Yorkshire — v roku 2020 prvýkrát postúpili do EFL, v roku 2026 zostúpili z League Two.
nodes.desc_en: The "Sulphurites" from the Yorkshire spa town — first promoted to the EFL in 2020, relegated from League Two in 2026.

nodes.name: Hartlepool United
nodes.desc: „Pools“ zo severovýchodného pobrežia, Victoria Park — v roku 2017 vypadli z Football League po 96 rokoch; trénerskú kariéru tu začal Brian Clough.
nodes.desc_en: The "Pools" from the north-east coast, Victoria Park — dropped out of the Football League in 2017 after 96 years; Brian Clough began his managerial career here.

nodes.name: Hornchurch
nodes.desc: „Urchins“ z východného Londýna — v roku 2021 vyhrali FA Trophy ako klub 7. úrovne a v roku 2026 postúpili cez play-off do National League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Urchins" from east London — won the FA Trophy in 2021 as a seventh-tier club and reached the National League via the 2026 play-offs.

nodes.name: Kidderminster Harriers
nodes.desc: Tradičný non-league klub z Worcestershire, Aggborough — v rokoch 2000–2005 hral v EFL, v roku 2026 sa vrátil do National League cez play-off North.
nodes.desc_en: Traditional non-league club from Worcestershire, Aggborough — played in the EFL in 2000–2005 and returned to the National League via the 2026 North play-offs.

nodes.name: Scunthorpe United
nodes.desc: „Iron“ z oceliarskeho mesta v Lincolnshire — v rokoch 1950–2022 hrali 72 rokov vo Football League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Iron" from the steel town in Lincolnshire — spent 72 years in the Football League, from 1950 to 2022.

nodes.name: Solihull Moors
nodes.desc: Klub z West Midlands, Damson Park — vznikol v roku 2007 zlúčením Moor Green a Solihull Borough, do National League postúpil v roku 2016.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the West Midlands, Damson Park — formed in 2007 by the merger of Moor Green and Solihull Borough, promoted to the National League in 2016.

nodes.name: Southend United
nodes.desc: „Shrimpers“ z prímorského Essexu, Roots Hall — po 101 rokoch vo Football League (1920–2021) v roku 2026 prvýkrát vyhrali FA Trophy.
nodes.desc_en: The "Shrimpers" from coastal Essex, Roots Hall — after 101 years in the Football League (1920–2021), won their first FA Trophy in 2026.

nodes.name: Sutton United
nodes.desc: Juholondýnsky klub známy pohárovými prekvapeniami — v FA Cupe 1988/89 vyradil Coventry City, v rokoch 2021–2024 hral v EFL.
nodes.desc_en: South London club known for cup upsets — knocked Coventry City out of the 1988/89 FA Cup and played in the EFL from 2021 to 2024.

nodes.name: Tamworth
nodes.desc: „The Lambs“ zo Staffordshire, The Lamb Ground — v ročníku 2023/24 vyhrali National League North; v FA Cupe 2024/25 podľahli Tottenhamu až po predĺžení.
nodes.desc_en: "The Lambs" from Staffordshire, The Lamb Ground — won the 2023/24 National League North; lost to Tottenham only after extra time in the 2024/25 FA Cup.

nodes.name: Wealdstone
nodes.desc: Klub zo severozápadného Londýna, kde hral Stuart Pearce — v ročníku 1984/85 ako prvý získal non-league double (ligu aj FA Trophy).
nodes.desc_en: North-west London club where Stuart Pearce played — in 1984/85 became the first club to win the non-league double (league and FA Trophy).

nodes.name: Woking
nodes.desc: „Cards“ zo Surrey, Kingfield Stadium — trojnásobný víťaz FA Trophy (1994, 1995, 1997).
nodes.desc_en: The "Cards" from Surrey, the Kingfield Stadium — three-time FA Trophy winners (1994, 1995, 1997).

nodes.name: Worthing
nodes.desc: „Rebels“, prímorský klub zo Sussexu (zal. 1886) — v ročníku 2025/26 vyhrali National League South a prvýkrát postúpili do National League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Rebels", a seaside club from Sussex (founded 1886) — won the 2025/26 National League South and reached the National League for the first time.

nodes.name: Yeovil Town
nodes.desc: „Glovers" zo Somersetu, kedysi účastník Championship
nodes.desc_en: The "Glovers" from Somerset, once a Championship side

nodes.name: National League North
nodes.desc: National League North má 24 klubov — AFC Telford United, Bedford Town, Brackley Town a Buxton. Šiesta úroveň — severná vetva National League, poloprofesionálne kluby.
nodes.desc_en: National League North has 24 clubs — AFC Telford United, Bedford Town, Brackley Town and Buxton. Sixth tier — northern branch of the National League, semi-professional clubs.

nodes.name: AFC Telford United
nodes.desc: Klub zo Shropshire, New Bucks Head — založený v roku 2004 po zániku Telford United, v ročníku 2013/14 vyhral Conference North.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Shropshire, New Bucks Head — founded in 2004 after Telford United folded, Conference North champions in 2013–14.

nodes.name: Bedford Town
nodes.desc: „Orly" z Bedfordu, klub obnovený fanúšikmi 1989
nodes.desc_en: The "Eagles" from Bedford, refounded by fans in 1989

nodes.name: Brackley Town
nodes.desc: Úspešný non-league klub z Northamptonshire — víťaz FA Trophy 2018 a šampión National League North 2024/25.
nodes.desc_en: Successful non-league club from Northamptonshire — FA Trophy winners in 2018 and National League North champions in 2024–25.

nodes.name: Buxton
nodes.desc: Najvyššie položený klub Anglicka — kúpeľné mesto v Peak District
nodes.desc_en: England's highest-altitude club — a spa town in the Peak District

nodes.name: Chester
nodes.desc: Fanúšikmi vlastnený klub z historického mesta pri waleskej hranici
nodes.desc_en: Fan-owned club from the historic city near the Welsh border

nodes.name: Chorley
nodes.desc: „Magpies“ z Lancashire — v FA Cupe 2020/21 sa dostali do 4. kola, keď vyradili Wigan, Peterborough aj Derby County.
nodes.desc_en: The "Magpies" from Lancashire — reached the FA Cup fourth round in 2020–21, knocking out Wigan, Peterborough and Derby County.

nodes.name: Darlington
nodes.desc: „Quakers" zo severovýchodu, klub obnovený fanúšikmi
nodes.desc_en: The "Quakers" from the north-east, a fan-refounded club

nodes.name: Harborough Town
nodes.desc: Rýchlo rastúci klub z Leicestershire — „Bees“ v ročníku 2025/26 vyhrali Southern League Premier Central a postúpili do National League North.
nodes.desc_en: Fast-growing club from Leicestershire — the "Bees" won the Southern League Premier Central in 2025–26 and were promoted to the National League North.

nodes.name: Hebburn Town
nodes.desc: Klub od rieky Tyne, založený v roku 1912 — víťaz FA Vase 2019/20 a v ročníku 2025/26 šampión Northern Premier League.
nodes.desc_en: Club on the river Tyne, founded in 1912 — FA Vase winners in 2019–20 and Northern Premier League champions in 2025–26.

nodes.name: Hednesford Town
nodes.desc: „Pitmen“ — baníci zo Staffordshire, víťaz FA Trophy 2004; v roku 2026 postúpili do National League North cez play-off.
nodes.desc_en: The "Pitmen" — miners from Staffordshire, FA Trophy winners in 2004; promoted to the National League North via the play-offs in 2026.

nodes.name: Hereford
nodes.desc: Nástupca Hereford United založený v decembri 2014, Edgar Street — finalista FA Vase 2016 a šampión Southern League 2017/18.
nodes.desc_en: Successor to Hereford United founded in December 2014, Edgar Street — FA Vase finalists in 2016 and Southern League champions in 2017–18.

nodes.name: King’s Lynn Town
nodes.desc: „Linnets“ z Norfolku — klub obnovený v roku 2010, v ročníku 2019/20 šampión National League North.
nodes.desc_en: The "Linnets" from Norfolk — refounded in 2010, National League North champions in 2019–20.

nodes.name: Macclesfield
nodes.desc: Klub z Cheshire založený v roku 2020, Moss Rose — v januári 2026 vyradil v FA Cupe obhajcu Crystal Palace 2:1.
nodes.desc_en: Cheshire club founded in 2020, Moss Rose — knocked FA Cup holders Crystal Palace out 2–1 in January 2026.

nodes.name: Marine
nodes.desc: Klub z Crosby pri Liverpoole, preslávený zápasom s Tottenhamom v FA Cupe
nodes.desc_en: Club from Crosby near Liverpool, famous for their FA Cup tie against Tottenham

nodes.name: Merthyr Town
nodes.desc: Waleský fanúšikovský klub v anglickej pyramíde — „Martyrs“ v ročníku 2024/25 vyhrali Southern League Premier South.
nodes.desc_en: Welsh fan-owned club in the English pyramid — the "Martyrs" won the Southern League Premier South in 2024–25.

nodes.name: Morecambe
nodes.desc: „Krevety“ z prímorského Lancashire — v Football League hrali v rokoch 2007–2025, FA Trophy vyhrali v ročníku 1973/74.
nodes.desc_en: The "Shrimps" from coastal Lancashire — played in the Football League from 2007 to 2025 and won the FA Trophy in 1973–74.

nodes.name: Oxford City
nodes.desc: Druhý oxfordský klub — „Hoops“ vyhrali FA Amateur Cup v roku 1906 a v sezóne 2023/24 hrali National League.
nodes.desc_en: Oxford's second club — the "Hoops" won the FA Amateur Cup in 1906 and played in the National League in 2023–24.

nodes.name: Radcliffe
nodes.desc: Klub z Veľkého Manchestru založený v roku 1949 — v ročníku 2023/24 vyhral Northern Premier League a postúpil do National League North.
nodes.desc_en: Greater Manchester club founded in 1949 — won the Northern Premier League in 2023–24 and was promoted to the National League North.

nodes.name: Scarborough Athletic
nodes.desc: Prímorský klub z Yorkshire, založený fanúšikmi v roku 2007 — v roku 2022 postúpil do National League North cez play-off.
nodes.desc_en: Seaside club from Yorkshire, founded by fans in 2007 — promoted to the National League North via the play-offs in 2022.

nodes.name: South Shields
nodes.desc: Ambiciózny klub od ústia rieky Tyne — „Mariners“ vyhrali FA Vase 2017 a v ročníku 2022/23 Northern Premier League.
nodes.desc_en: Ambitious club at the mouth of the river Tyne — the "Mariners" won the FA Vase in 2017 and the Northern Premier League in 2022–23.

nodes.name: Southport
nodes.desc: „Sandgrounders“ z prímorského letoviska — v Football League hrali v rokoch 1921–1978, v roku 1931 došli do štvrťfinále FA Cupu.
nodes.desc_en: The "Sandgrounders" from the seaside resort — Football League members from 1921 to 1978, FA Cup quarter-finalists in 1931.

nodes.name: Spalding United
nodes.desc: „Tulips“ z Lincolnshire, založení v roku 1905 — v roku 2026 postúpili do National League North cez play-off Southern League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Tulips" from Lincolnshire, founded in 1905 — promoted to the National League North via the Southern League play-offs in 2026.

nodes.name: Spennymoor Town
nodes.desc: „Moors“ z grófstva Durham, založení v roku 2005 — víťaz FA Vase 2013 a finalista FA Trophy 2025.
nodes.desc_en: The "Moors" from County Durham, founded in 2005 — FA Vase winners in 2013 and FA Trophy finalists in 2025.

nodes.name: Worksop Town
nodes.desc: Jeden z najstarších klubov sveta (1861)
nodes.desc_en: One of the oldest clubs in the world (1861)

nodes.name: National League South
nodes.desc: National League South má 24 klubov — AFC Totton, Billericay Town, Braintree Town a Chelmsford City. Šiesta úroveň — južná vetva National League, poloprofesionálne kluby.
nodes.desc_en: National League South has 24 clubs — AFC Totton, Billericay Town, Braintree Town and Chelmsford City. Sixth tier — southern branch of the National League, semi-professional clubs.

nodes.name: AFC Totton
nodes.desc: Klub z Hampshire pri Southamptone, „Stags“ — v roku 2025 postúpil do National League South po výhre 1:0 nad Gloucester City vo finále play-off.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Hampshire, near Southampton, the "Stags" — promoted to the National League South in 2025 after a 1–0 play-off final win over Gloucester City.

nodes.name: Billericay Town
nodes.desc: Klub z Essexu, štadión New Lodge — trojnásobný víťaz FA Vase (1976, 1977, 1979), v roku 2026 sa cez play-off Isthmian League vrátil do National League South.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Essex, New Lodge ground — three-time FA Vase winners (1976, 1977, 1979), returned to the National League South in 2026 via the Isthmian League play-offs.

nodes.name: Braintree Town
nodes.desc: „Iron“ z Essexu, štadión Cressing Road — majster Conference South 2010/11, v roku 2026 zostúpil z National League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Iron" from Essex, Cressing Road ground — Conference South champions in 2010–11, relegated from the National League in 2026.

nodes.name: Chelmsford City
nodes.desc: „Clarets“ z hlavného mesta Essexu — majster Southern League 1967/68 a 1971/72, od roku 2006 hrá na Melbourne Stadium.
nodes.desc_en: The "Clarets" from the county town of Essex — Southern League champions in 1967–68 and 1971–72, playing at Melbourne Stadium since 2006.

nodes.name: Chesham United
nodes.desc: „Generals“ z Buckinghamshire, štadión The Meadow — finalista FA Amateur Cupu 1968, do National League South postúpil v roku 2024 ako majster Southern League.
nodes.desc_en: The "Generals" from Buckinghamshire, The Meadow ground — FA Amateur Cup finalists in 1968, promoted to the National League South in 2024 as Southern League champions.

nodes.name: Dagenham & Redbridge
nodes.desc: „Daggers“ z východného Londýna, založení 1992 — v rokoch 2007–2016 hrali EFL (2010/11 aj League One), v roku 2025 zostúpili do National League South.
nodes.desc_en: The "Daggers" from east London, founded in 1992 — played in the EFL from 2007 to 2016 (League One in 2010–11), relegated to the National League South in 2025.

nodes.name: Dorking Wanderers
nodes.desc: Klub zo Surrey s raketovým vzostupom z okresných líg
nodes.desc_en: Club from Surrey with a meteoric rise from grassroots football

nodes.name: Dover Athletic
nodes.desc: Klub z prístavu pri Lamanšskom prielive, založený 1983 — domovom je štadión Crabble, v FA Cupe sa dostal do 3. kola v sezónach 2010/11 a 2014/15.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the port town on the English Channel, founded in 1983 — home is the Crabble ground; reached the FA Cup third round in 2010–11 and 2014–15.

nodes.name: Ebbsfleet United
nodes.desc: Klub z Kentu, štadión Stonebridge Road — víťaz FA Trophy 2008 (1:0 nad Torquay) a majster National League South 2022/23.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kent, Stonebridge Road ground — FA Trophy winners in 2008 (1–0 vs Torquay) and National League South champions in 2022–23.

nodes.name: Farnborough
nodes.desc: Klub z Hampshire založený v roku 1967, štadión Cherrywood Road — do National League South postúpil v roku 2022 cez play-off.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Hampshire founded in 1967, Cherrywood Road ground — promoted to the National League South via the play-offs in 2022.

nodes.name: Farnham Town
nodes.desc: Komunitný klub zo Surrey založený v roku 1906 — postúpil trikrát za sebou (2024, 2025, 2026), naposledy cez play-off do National League South.
