nodes.desc: Argentínsky šport v Radio Mitre – Boca a River pred Superclásicom, Liga Profesional, Ascenso, Selección, Los Pumas, tenis a F1, k tomu podcasty a živé vysielanie. Rozhlasová stanica z Buenos Aires (od 1925).
nodes.desc_en: Argentine sport on Radio Mitre – Boca and River ahead of the Superclásico, the Liga Profesional, Ascenso, the Selección, Los Pumas, tennis and F1, plus podcasts and live radio. Buenos Aires radio station (since 1925).

nodes.name: El Gráfico
nodes.desc: Argentínsky El Gráfico – Primera División, Copa Argentina, Selección, Messi a Maradona, tenis, basketbal, box, motoršport, ragby a archív obálok. Športový časopis od 1919, od 2018 len online.
nodes.desc_en: Argentina's El Gráfico – Primera División, Copa Argentina, the Selección, Messi and Maradona, tennis, basketball, boxing, motorsport, rugby and a cover archive. Sports magazine since 1919, online-only since 2018.

nodes.name: Bolavip Argentina
nodes.desc: Boca a River denne na Bolavip Argentina – Clausura, Primera Nacional, Copa Argentina, Selección, Libertadores, európske ligy, F1, NBA, box a UFC. Argentínske vydanie siete Bolavip (od 2010, Futbol Sites).
nodes.desc_en: Boca and River daily on Bolavip Argentina – the Clausura, Primera Nacional, Copa Argentina, the Selección, Libertadores, European leagues, F1, NBA and UFC. Argentine edition of the Bolavip network (since 2010, Futbol Sites).

nodes.name: TNT Sports Argentina
nodes.desc: Domáca Liga Profesional na TNT Sports Argentina – správy z ligy a o kluboch, národný a medzinárodný futbal, ženský futbal, Selección, basketbal, videá, štatistiky a program. Web športového kanála (od 2017).
nodes.desc_en: The domestic Liga Profesional on TNT Sports Argentina – league and club news, national and international football, women's football, the Selección, basketball, videos, stats and TV schedule. Sports channel website (since 2017).

nodes.name: Vermouth Deportivo
nodes.desc: Argentínsky futbal „v štýle Ascensa aj Primery“ na Vermouth Deportivo – LPF, Primera Nacional, Primera B Metropolitana, Primera C, Federal A, Selección a Messi, tabuľky. Nezávislý športový web (od 2006).
nodes.desc_en: Argentine football from Ascenso to Primera on Vermouth Deportivo – the LPF, Primera Nacional, Primera B Metropolitana, Primera C, Federal A, the Selección and Messi, plus standings. Independent sports site (since 2006).

nodes.name: DeporTV
nodes.desc: Argentínsky štátny kanál DeporTV – motoršport (TC, Dakar), Liga Profesional a Ascenso, basketbal LNB, tenis, volejbal, ragby, box a hokej na tráve. Verejnoprávny športový kanál (od 2012).
nodes.desc_en: Argentina's public channel DeporTV – motorsport (TC, Dakar), Liga Profesional and Ascenso, LNB basketball, tennis, volleyball, rugby, boxing and field hockey. Public sports channel (since 2012).

nodes.name: BDFA
nodes.desc: Databáza argentínskeho futbalu BDFA – profily hráčov a klubov od Primera División po Primera D a Federal B, kluby podľa provincií, reprezentácie aj zahraničné ligy. Dobrovoľnícka futbalová databáza.
nodes.desc_en: BDFA, the Argentine football database – player and club profiles from Primera División down to Primera D and Federal B, clubs by province, national teams, Libertadores and foreign leagues. Volunteer-run football database.

nodes.name: Básquet Plus
nodes.desc: Argentínsky basketbal na Básquet Plus – Liga Nacional (LNB), Liga Argentina, Federal, ženy, Selección a NBA, výsledky, tabuľky, štatistiky, videá a podcast. Basketbalový portál (na webe od 2016).
nodes.desc_en: Argentine basketball on Básquet Plus – Liga Nacional (LNB), Liga Argentina, Federal, women, the national team and the NBA, with results, tables, stats, videos and a podcast. Basketball portal (online since 2016).

nodes.name: Carburando
nodes.desc: Argentínsky motoršport na Carburando – Turismo Carretera, TC2000, národné súťaže, Argentínčania v zahraničí a F1 s Francom Colapintom, kalendár a správy. Motoristické médium Grupo Clarín (od 1960).
nodes.desc_en: Argentine motorsport on Carburando – Turismo Carretera, TC2000, national series, Argentines abroad and F1 with Franco Colapinto, plus calendar and news. Grupo Clarín motorsport outlet (since 1960).

nodes.name: Rugby Champagne
nodes.desc: Argentínske ragby na Rugby Champagne – URBA Top 14 a nižšie divízie, provincie, Nacional de Clubes, Los Pumas, Pumitas, Super Rugby Américas, štatistiky a rádio. Ragbyové médium (od 1996).
nodes.desc_en: Argentine rugby on Rugby Champagne – URBA Top 14 and lower divisions, provincial unions, Nacional de Clubes, Los Pumas, Pumitas, Super Rugby Américas, Rugby Championship, stats and radio. Rugby media outlet (since 1996).

nodes.name: Clarín deportes
nodes.desc: Šport z Buenos Aires v denníku Clarín – Boca, River a Liga Profesional, Selección, Messi, európsky futbal, F1, tenis, agenda a štatistiky. Športová sekcia argentínskeho denníka (od 1945, Grupo Clarín).
nodes.desc_en: Sport from Buenos Aires in Clarín – Boca, River and the Liga Profesional, the Selección, Messi, European football, F1, tennis, plus schedule and stats. Sports section of the Argentine daily (since 1945, Grupo Clarín).

nodes.name: La Nación deportes
nodes.desc: Boca, River a domáci Clausura v La Nación – futbal, ragby, tenis, Selección a komentáre stálych športových publicistov. Športová sekcia buenosaireského denníka (od 1870).
nodes.desc_en: Boca, River and the domestic Clausura in La Nación – football, rugby, tennis, the Selección and columns by regular sports writers. Sports section of the Buenos Aires daily (since 1870).

nodes.name: Infobae deportes
nodes.desc: Argentínsky šport na Infobae – Boca Juniors, Selección, Primera Nacional, Copa Argentina, Libertadores, LaLiga, Premier League a MLS, výsledky a tabuľky. Športová sekcia spravodajského portálu (od 2002).
nodes.desc_en: Argentine sport on Infobae – Boca Juniors, the Selección, Primera Nacional, Copa Argentina, Libertadores, LaLiga, Premier League, Liga MX and MLS, with scores and tables. Sports section of the news portal (since 2002).

nodes.name: Página/12 deportes
nodes.desc: Z Argentíny športová sekcia Página/12 – domáci futbal, Copa Sudamericana, Selección, Argentínčania v Európe a športové témy so spoločenským presahom. Buenosaireský denník (od 1987, Grupo Octubre).
nodes.desc_en: Sport from Argentina in Página/12 – domestic football, the Copa Sudamericana, the Selección, Argentines in Europe and sport stories with a social angle. Buenos Aires daily (since 1987, Grupo Octubre).

nodes.name: Crónica Depo
nodes.desc: Buenosaireský šport v Depo denníka Crónica – Liga Profesional, Ascenso, Copa Argentina, Selección, „Mundo Xeneize“ o Boca, tenis, basketbal, ragby a eSports. Športová sekcia bulvárneho denníka (od 1963).
nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires sport in Crónica's Depo – Liga Profesional, Ascenso, Copa Argentina, the Selección, Mundo Xeneize on Boca, tennis, basketball, rugby and esports. Sports section of the tabloid daily (since 1963).

nodes.name: Diario Popular deportes
nodes.desc: Argentínsky Clausura v Diario Popular – Boca, River, Racing, tabla anual, príbehy hráčov, európsky futbal a F1 s Colapintom. Športová sekcia populárneho buenosaireského denníka (od 1974).
nodes.desc_en: Argentina's Clausura in Diario Popular – Boca, River, Racing, the annual table, player stories, European football and F1 with Colapinto. Sports section of the popular Buenos Aires daily (since 1974).

nodes.name: Perfil deportes
nodes.desc: Argentínsky futbal v denníku Perfil – River a Boca, Selección, Libertadores, juniorské reprezentácie, Argentínčania v Európe a rôzne športy. Športová sekcia denníka vydavateľstva Editorial Perfil.
nodes.desc_en: Argentine football in Perfil – River and Boca, the Selección, Libertadores, youth national teams, Argentines in Europe and other sports. Sports section of the Editorial Perfil newspaper.

nodes.name: El Destape deportes
nodes.desc: Racing, Independiente a domáci futbal na El Destape – správy o kluboch Liga Profesional, Selección a Scaloni, futbal v Argentíne aj vo svete. Športová sekcia webu novinára Roberta Navarra.
nodes.desc_en: Racing, Independiente and domestic football on El Destape – Liga Profesional club news, the Selección and Scaloni, football in Argentina and abroad. Sports section of journalist Roberto Navarro's website.

nodes.name: Tiempo Argentino deportes
nodes.desc: Argentínsky šport v Tiempo Argentino – Boca a Estudiantes v pohároch, Selección, ženský futbal, fanúšikovská kultúra a reportáže. Športová sekcia denníka (od 2010), od 2016 ho vydáva družstvo novinárov.
nodes.desc_en: Argentine sport in Tiempo Argentino – Boca and Estudiantes in the cups, the Selección, women's football, fan culture and features. Sports section of the daily (since 2010), published by a journalists' cooperative since 2016.

nodes.name: Ámbito deportes
nodes.desc: Buenosaireský šport v denníku Ámbito – River, Boca a AFA, Argentínčania v Európe, Colapinto vo F1, NBA, box aj golf. Športová sekcia ekonomického denníka (od 1976).
nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires sport in Ámbito – River, Boca and the AFA, Argentines in Europe, Colapinto in F1, the NBA, boxing and golf. Sports section of the business daily (since 1976).

nodes.name: El Día deportes
nodes.desc: Šport z La Platy v El Día – Estudiantes a Gimnasia, Copa Libertadores, celoštátny futbal a Selección. Športová sekcia denníka z hlavného mesta provincie Buenos Aires (od 1884).
nodes.desc_en: Sport from La Plata in El Día – Estudiantes and Gimnasia, the Copa Libertadores, national football and the Selección. Sports section of the daily from the capital of Buenos Aires province (since 1884).

nodes.name: Los Andes deportes
nodes.desc: Šport z Mendozy v Los Andes – miestne kluby a golf, River, Boca, Clausura, Argentínčania v Európe, NBA, box a F1 s Colapintom. Športová sekcia mendozského denníka (od 1883).
nodes.desc_en: Sport from Mendoza in Los Andes – local clubs and golf, River, Boca, the Clausura, Argentines in Europe, the NBA, boxing and F1 with Colapinto. Sports section of the Mendoza daily (since 1883).

nodes.name: La Gaceta deportes
nodes.desc: Šport z Tucumánu v La Gaceta – Atlético Tucumán a semifinále Copa Argentina, Boca a River, F1 s Colapintom a futbalové štatistiky. Športová sekcia tucumánskeho denníka (od 1912).
nodes.desc_en: Sport from Tucumán in La Gaceta – Atlético Tucumán and its Copa Argentina semi-final, Boca and River, F1 with Colapinto and football stats. Sports section of the Tucumán daily (since 1912).

nodes.name: 4 Semanas deportes
nodes.desc: Argentínska reprezentácia a Messi na 4 Semanas – Selección, Scaloni, kluby Liga Profesional a box. Športová rubrika celoštátneho spravodajského webu, články vychádzajú nepravidelne.
nodes.desc_en: Argentina's national team and Messi on 4 Semanas – the Selección, Scaloni, Liga Profesional clubs and boxing. Sports section of a national news website, with articles published irregularly.

nodes.name: La Arena deportes
nodes.desc: Šport z provincie La Pampa v La Arena – pampská futbalová liga, miestny basketbal, pampskí športovci vo svete, Colapinto vo F1 a celoštátny futbal. Športová sekcia ranného denníka zo Santa Rosy.
nodes.desc_en: Sport from La Pampa province in La Arena – the Pampa football league, local basketball, Pampa athletes abroad, Colapinto in F1 and national football. Sports section of the morning daily from Santa Rosa.

nodes.name: Puntal deportes
nodes.desc: Šport z Río Cuarto v Puntal – Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, Atenas, regionálna futbalová liga, Federal A, bochas, Copa Argentina, Boca a River. Športová sekcia denníka z juhu provincie Córdoba.
nodes.desc_en: Sport from Río Cuarto in Puntal – Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, Atenas, the regional football league, Federal A, bocce, the Copa Argentina, Boca and River. Sports section of the daily from southern Córdoba province.

nodes.name: El Tribuno deportes
nodes.desc: Šport zo Salty v El Tribuno – Central Norte, Gimnasia y Tiro, Federal A, miestny box a rely, Dakar, Superclásico Boca – River a celoštátny futbal. Športová sekcia saltského denníka (od 1949).
nodes.desc_en: Sport from Salta in El Tribuno – Central Norte, Gimnasia y Tiro, Federal A, local boxing and rally, the Dakar, the Boca–River Superclásico and national football. Sports section of the Salta daily (since 1949).

nodes.name: GFA League
nodes.desc: Najvyššia gambijská súťaž — 16 klubov vrátane Real de Banjul, Gambia Ports Authority a Brikama United.
nodes.desc_en: Top Gambian league — 16 clubs including Real de Banjul, Gambia Ports Authority and Brikama United.

nodes.name: Medina United FA
nodes.desc: Klub z dediny Lamin, majster GFA League 2025/26 – debutový titul po víťazstve v FF Cupe 2024.
nodes.desc_en: From the village of Lamin, champions of the 2025/26 GFA League — their first title, after winning the 2024 FF Cup.

nodes.name: Fortune FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Farata pri Serrekunde, majster ligy 2021, vicemajster sezóny 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From Farato near Serrekunda, league champions in 2021 and runners-up in 2025/26.

nodes.name: Gambia Ports Authority FC
nodes.desc: Klub prístavného úradu z Banjulu s prezývkou „The Ferry Boys“.
nodes.desc_en: The port authority's club from Banjul, nicknamed "the Ferry Boys".

nodes.name: Bombada FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Brikamy (Bombada je tradičný názov mesta), stabilný tím strednej tabuľky.
nodes.desc_en: From Brikama (Bombada is the town's traditional name), a steady mid-table side.

nodes.name: Brikama United FC
nodes.desc: Dvojnásobný gambijský majster z Brikamy, hráva aj v afrických CAF pohároch.
nodes.desc_en: Two-time Gambian champions from Brikama, who have also competed in CAF continental competitions.

nodes.name: Real de Banjul FC
nodes.desc: Obhajca titulu z 2024/25, druhý najúspešnejší klub v histórii Gambie s 15 titulmi.
nodes.desc_en: Defending champions from 2024/25, the second most successful club in Gambian history with 15 titles.

nodes.name: BST Galaxy FC
nodes.desc: Mladý klub z Banjulu založený 2022, postúpil do najvyššej súťaže už v roku 2023.
nodes.desc_en: A young club from Banjul founded in 2022, reaching the top flight just a year later in 2023.

nodes.name: Hart Academy FC
nodes.desc: Akadémia s ambíciami hrajúca v hornej polovici tabuľky.
nodes.desc_en: An academy-club competing in the upper half of the table.

nodes.name: Team Rhino FC
nodes.desc: Gambia — klub založený v roku 2012; do najvyššej súťaže GFA League postúpil v roku 2021 po víťazstve v baráži nad Gunjur United (2:1).
nodes.desc_en: Gambia — club founded in 2012; promoted to the GFA League First Division in 2021 after a 2–1 play-off win over Gunjur United.

nodes.name: Falcons FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Wellingary (Abuko, KMC), postúpil po titule v 2. lige 2020/21.
nodes.desc_en: From Wellingara (Abuko, KMC), promoted after winning the second-division title in 2020/21.

nodes.name: The Gambian Dutch Lions FC
nodes.desc: Nový klub s holandským prepojením, debutuje v najvyššej súťaži.
nodes.desc_en: A newly founded club with Dutch ties, making its debut in the top flight.

nodes.name: Greater Tomorrow FA
nodes.desc: Klub z Brikamy, pôvodne akadémia z roku 2008, dnes plnohodnotný prvoligový klub.
nodes.desc_en: From Brikama, originally founded as a youth academy in 2008, now a fully-fledged top-flight club.

nodes.name: Hawks FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Banjulu/Kanifingu, tretí najúspešnejší v histórii Gambie s 3 titulmi.
nodes.desc_en: From Banjul/Kanifing, the third most successful club in Gambian history with three league titles.

nodes.name: TMT Football Academy
nodes.desc: Klub zo Serrekundy/Abuko s medzinárodnými partnerstvami a hráčmi v mládežníckych reprezentáciách.

nodes.name: Samger FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Kanifingu pri Serrekunde, založený 2003, postúpil do najvyššej súťaže.
nodes.desc_en: From Kanifing near Serrekunda, founded in 2003, promoted to the top division.

nodes.name: Steve Biko FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Bakau, založený 1978, víťaz GFA Cupu 2000.
nodes.desc_en: From Bakau, founded in 1978, winners of the GFA Cup in 2000.

nodes.name: Premier League
nodes.desc: Najvyššia ghanská súťaž — 18 klubov vrátane Asante Kotoko, Hearts of Oak a Medeama SC.

nodes.name: Medeama SC
nodes.desc: Klub z Tarkwy, majster sezóny 2025/26 (2. titul), postup do CAF Ligy majstrov.
nodes.desc_en: From Tarkwa, champions of the 2025/26 season (their 2nd title), qualifying for the CAF Champions League.

nodes.name: Bibiani GoldStars
nodes.desc: Klub z Bibiani s prezývkou „Baníci“, tesný vicemajster 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From Bibiani, nicknamed "the Miners", narrow runners-up in 2025/26.

nodes.name: Hearts of Oak
nodes.desc: Klub z Akry, najúspešnejší v histórii ghanského futbalu, tradičný rival Asante Kotoko.
nodes.desc_en: From Accra, the most successful club in Ghanaian football history and traditional rival of Asante Kotoko.

nodes.name: Dreams FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Dawu, víťaz FA Cupu 2022/23, štvrté miesto v sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From Dawu, FA Cup winners in 2022/23, finished fourth in 2025/26.

nodes.name: Aduana Stars
nodes.desc: Klub z Dormaa Ahenkro v regióne Bono, dvojnásobný ligový majster.
nodes.desc_en: From Dormaa Ahenkro in the Bono Region, two-time league champions.

nodes.name: Samartex
nodes.desc: Klub z Samreboi, obhajca titulu z 2023/24, podporovaný drevárskou spoločnosťou.
nodes.desc_en: From Samreboi, defending the 2023/24 title, backed by a timber company.

nodes.name: Karela United
nodes.desc: Klub z Aiyinase, prvý klub z regiónu Nzema v najvyššej súťaži (od 2017).

nodes.name: Berekum Chelsea

nodes.desc_en: Berekum — club founded in 2004, Ghana Premier League champions in 2010/11; reached the CAF Champions League group stage in 2012 and play at Golden City Park.

nodes.name: Vision FC
nodes.desc: Klub z prístavného mesta Tema, mladší tím strednej tabuľky.
nodes.desc_en: From the port city of Tema, a newer club settled in mid-table.

nodes.name: Asante Kotoko
nodes.desc: Klub z Kumasi, rekordný 24-násobný majster Ghany, dvojnásobný víťaz CAF Ligy majstrov, prezývka „Porcupine Warriors“.
nodes.desc_en: From Kumasi, record 24-time Ghanaian champions and two-time CAF Champions League winners, nicknamed the "Porcupine Warriors".

nodes.name: Swedru All Blacks
nodes.desc: Klub z Agona Swedru, návrat do najvyššej súťaže po 16 rokoch.
nodes.desc_en: From Agona Swedru, back in the top flight after 16 years away.

nodes.name: Young Apostles FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Wenchi v regióne Bono, založený 2012.
nodes.desc_en: From Wenchi in the Bono Region, founded in 2012.

nodes.name: Bechem United
nodes.desc: Klub z regiónu Ahafo s prezývkou „Hunters“, debutoval v CAF Confederation Cupe.
nodes.desc_en: From the Ahafo Region, nicknamed "the Hunters", made their CAF Confederation Cup debut.

nodes.name: Basake Holy Stars
nodes.desc: Klub z Nzema-Basake v Západnej provincii, zameraný na mladé talenty.
nodes.desc_en: From Nzema-Basake in the Western Region, a club focused on developing young talent.

nodes.name: Heart of Lions
nodes.desc: Klub z Kpando vo Volte, zostúpil po sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From Kpando in the Volta Region, relegated after the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: Horoya AC
nodes.desc: Klub z Conakry, rekordný 22-násobný majster Guiney.
nodes.desc_en: From Conakry, a record 22-time Guinean champion.

nodes.name: Hafia FC

nodes.name: CI Kamsar
nodes.desc: Klub priemyselnej spoločnosti z ťažobného mesta Kamsar, tretie miesto v sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From the mining town of Kamsar, backed by the local industrial company, finished third in 2025/26.

nodes.name: AS Kaloum Star
nodes.desc: Klub z najstaršej štvrte Conakry (Kaloum), založený 1963.
nodes.desc_en: From Kaloum, Conakry's oldest district, founded in 1963.

nodes.name: Milo FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Kankanu vo Vysokej Guinei, majster ligy 2024.
nodes.desc_en: From Kankan in Upper Guinea, league champions in 2024.

nodes.name: Wakriya AC

nodes.name: ASFAG

nodes.desc_en: The club of Guinea's armed forces, based in Conakry (AS des Forces Armées de Guinée); the link leads to the multi-sport club's official Facebook page.

nodes.name: ASM Sangarédi
nodes.desc: Klub z ťažobného mesta Sangarédi (bauxit); odkaz vedie na oficiálnu stránku klubu na Facebooku.
nodes.desc_en: From the bauxite-mining town of Sangarédi; the link leads to the club's official Facebook page.

nodes.name: AAGB Siguiri
nodes.desc: Klub zlatorudnej spoločnosti AngloGold z mesta Siguiri.
nodes.desc_en: The club of the AngloGold mining company in Siguiri.

nodes.name: RCC Kamsar
nodes.desc: Druhý klub z ťažobného mesta Kamsar popri CI Kamsar; odkaz vedie na oficiálnu stránku klubu na Facebooku.
nodes.desc_en: The town of Kamsar's second club alongside CI Kamsar; the link leads to the club's official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Karfamoriah FC
nodes.desc: Mladší klub z Kankanu, postúpil do Ligy 1 v tejto sezóne.
nodes.desc_en: A newer club from Kankan, promoted to Ligue 1 this season.

nodes.name: Guinée Foot Élite
nodes.desc: Akadémia z Coléah (Conakry), tesne sa zachránila pred zostupom.
nodes.desc_en: An academy-based club from Coléah, Conakry, that narrowly avoided relegation.

nodes.name: Renaissance FC
nodes.desc: Historický klub z Conakry, zostúpil po sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: A historic Conakry club, relegated after the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: Loubha FCT
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Télimélé, zostúpil po sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From the town of Télimélé, relegated after the 2025/26 season.

nodes.desc_en: Second South African tier — 16 clubs fighting for promotion to the Premiership, including Cape Town City and Magesi FC. Other clubs include Gomora United FC, Hope FC, Midlands Wanderers FC and Highbury FC.

nodes.name: Orlando Pirates
nodes.desc: Klub zo Soweta s prezývkou „Buccaneers“, majster 2025/26 (5. titul, ukončil 8-ročnú éru Sundowns), víťaz Africkej ligy majstrov 1995.
nodes.desc_en: From Soweto, nicknamed "the Buccaneers", champions in 2025/26 (their 5th title, ending Sundowns' 8-year reign), 1995 African Champions League winners.

nodes.name: Mamelodi Sundowns
nodes.desc: Klub z Pretórie s prezývkou „Brazílčania“, obhajca 8 titulov v rade, víťaz Africkej ligy majstrov 2016.
nodes.desc_en: From Pretoria, nicknamed "the Brazilians", defending an 8-year title streak until 2025/26, 2016 African Champions League winners.

nodes.name: Kaizer Chiefs
nodes.desc: Klub z Johannesburgu (Naturena) s prezývkou „Amakhosi“, najpopulárnejší futbalový klub Južnej Afriky.
nodes.desc_en: From Naturena, Johannesburg, nicknamed "Amakhosi", South Africa's most-supported football club.

nodes.name: AmaZulu FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Durbanu s prezývkou „Usuthu“, reprezentuje provinciu KwaZulu-Natal.
nodes.desc_en: From Durban, nicknamed "Usuthu", representing the KwaZulu-Natal province.

nodes.name: Sekhukhune United
nodes.desc: Klub z Polokwane, od roku 2022 súčasť skupiny Mamelodi Sundowns.
nodes.desc_en: From Polokwane, a feeder club within the Mamelodi Sundowns group since 2022.

nodes.name: Lamontville Golden Arrows
nodes.desc: Tradičný klub z Umlazi pri Durbane s prezývkou „Abafana Bes'thende“.
nodes.desc_en: From Umlazi near Durban, nicknamed "Abafana Bes'thende", a traditional KwaZulu-Natal club.

nodes.name: Polokwane City FC
nodes.desc: Polokwane — klub založený v roku 2012 na základe licencie Bay United; do Premiership postúpil v rokoch 2013 a 2023, hrá na Old Peter Mokaba Stadium.
nodes.desc_en: Polokwane — club founded in 2012 using the Bay United franchise; promoted to the Premiership in 2013 and 2023, playing at Old Peter Mokaba Stadium.

nodes.name: Durban City FC
nodes.desc: Vznikol premenovaním a presunom klubu Maritzburg United z Pietermaritzburgu do Durbanu v roku 2024.
nodes.desc_en: Formed when Maritzburg United rebranded and relocated from Pietermaritzburg to Durban in 2024.

nodes.name: Stellenbosch FC
nodes.desc: Klub z univerzitného mesta Stellenbosch v Západnej Kapskej provincii.
nodes.desc_en: From the university town of Stellenbosch in the Western Cape.

nodes.name: Siwelele FC
nodes.desc: Vznikol v roku 2025 odkúpením ligovej licencie klubu SuperSport United, prevzal prezývku „Siwelele“ po zaniknutom Bloemfontein Celtic.
nodes.desc_en: Formed in 2025 after purchasing SuperSport United's league status, taking the "Siwelele" nickname once used by the defunct Bloemfontein Celtic.

nodes.name: Richards Bay FC
nodes.desc: Klub z prístavného mesta Richards Bay v KwaZulu-Natale, debutoval v najvyššej súťaži v roku 2022.
nodes.desc_en: From the port town of Richards Bay, KwaZulu-Natal, made their top-flight debut in 2022.

nodes.name: TS Galaxy FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Mbombely v provincii Mpumalanga, víťaz Južnoafrického FA Cupu (Nedbank Cup) 2019.
nodes.desc_en: From Mbombela in the Mpumalanga province, winners of the 2019 Nedbank Cup (South African FA Cup).

nodes.name: Chippa United
nodes.desc: Klub z Východnej Kapskej provincie s prezývkou „Chilli Boys“.
nodes.desc_en: From the Eastern Cape, nicknamed "the Chilli Boys".

nodes.name: Marumo Gallants FC
nodes.desc: Pôvodne klub z Limpopa s históriou viacerých premenovaní a presunov, dnes sídli v Bloemfonteine.
nodes.desc_en: Originally from Limpopo, a club with a history of several rebrandings and relocations, now based in Bloemfontein.

nodes.name: Magesi FC
nodes.desc: Klub zo Seshega pri Polokwane, predtým víťaz 2. ligy (Motsepe Foundation Championship), zostúpil po sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: From Seshego near Polokwane, former Motsepe Foundation Championship winners before promotion, relegated after 2025/26.

nodes.name: Orbit College FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Rustenburgu, debutoval v najvyššej súťaži v sezóne 2025/26 a hneď zostúpil.
nodes.desc_en: From Rustenburg, made their top-flight debut in 2025/26 and were relegated immediately.

nodes.name: Kruger United
nodes.desc: Klub z Bushbuckridge v provincii Mpumalanga s prezývkou „The Village Boys“, založený 2023 — majster sezóny 2025/26, postúpil do Premiership.
nodes.desc_en: From Bushbuckridge, Mpumalanga, nicknamed "the Village Boys", founded in 2023 — 2025/26 champions, promoted to the Premiership.

nodes.name: Cape Town City FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Kapského Mesta, zostúpil z Premiership v sezóne 2024/25, postup späť sa cez play-off nepodaril.
nodes.desc_en: From Cape Town, relegated from the Premiership in 2024/25, missed out on an immediate return via the promotion play-offs.

nodes.name: Milford FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Richards Bay, postúpil do Premiership pre sezónu 2026/27 cez play-off.
nodes.desc_en: From Richards Bay, KwaZulu-Natal, promoted to the Premiership for 2026/27 via the play-offs.

nodes.name: Real Native FC
nodes.desc: Klub z KwaMhlanga v provincii Mpumalanga, v roku 2026 premenovaný z Casric Stars na Real Native FC.
nodes.desc_en: From KwaMhlanga, Mpumalanga, renamed from Casric Stars to Real Native FC in 2026.

nodes.name: Hungry Lions FC
nodes.desc: Postmasburg (Severné Kapsko) — klub prezývaný „Malapipes“; v sezóne 2020/21 vyhral SAFA Second Division a postúpil do National First Division.
nodes.desc_en: Postmasburg (Northern Cape) — club nicknamed "Malapipes"; won the SAFA Second Division in 2020/21 to earn promotion to the National First Division.

nodes.name: Highbury FC
nodes.desc: Klub pôvodne z Durbanu, presunul sa do Východnej Kapskej provincie (Gqeberha) v roku 2012.
nodes.desc_en: Originally founded in Durban, relocated to the Eastern Cape (Gqeberha) in 2012.

nodes.name: Upington City FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Upingtonu v Severnom Kapsku, založený 2021.
nodes.desc_en: From Upington, Northern Cape, founded in 2021.

nodes.name: Lerumo Lions FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Bethanie v provincii North West, vznikol 2023 odkúpením licencie klubu Bokone NW.
nodes.desc_en: From Bethanie in the North West province, formed in 2023 after purchasing Bokone NW's league status.

nodes.name: Venda FC
nodes.desc: Thohoyandou — klub, predtým Venda Football Academy, hrajúci na Thohoyandou Stadium; súčasný názov nesie od sezóny 2023/24.
nodes.desc_en: Thohoyandou — club formerly known as Venda Football Academy, playing at Thohoyandou Stadium; took its current name in 2023/24.

nodes.name: The Bees FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Nkomati v provincii Mpumalanga, postúpil z regionálnej ligy v roku 2025.
nodes.desc_en: From Nkomati, Mpumalanga, promoted from the regional league in 2025.

nodes.name: University of Pretoria FC
nodes.desc: Futbalový klub Pretorijskej univerzity z Hatfieldu, prezývka „AmaTuks“.
nodes.desc_en: From Hatfield, Pretoria, the University of Pretoria's football club, nicknamed "AmaTuks".

nodes.name: Leicesterford City FC
nodes.desc: Klub z provincie Mpumalanga, založený 2025 odkúpením licencie klubu JDR Stars.
nodes.desc_en: From Mpumalanga, founded in 2025 after purchasing JDR Stars' league status.

nodes.name: Gomora United FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Alexandry/Tembisy (región Johannesburg), založený 2020, majster ABC Motsepe League 2025.
nodes.desc_en: From Alexandra/Tembisa in the Johannesburg region, founded in 2020, 2025 ABC Motsepe League champions.

nodes.name: Midlands Wanderers FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Pietermaritzburgu s prezývkou „Abafana Bebatha“, majster KwaZulu-Natalu v ABC Motsepe League 2024/25.
nodes.desc_en: From Pietermaritzburg, nicknamed "Abafana Bebatha", 2024/25 KwaZulu-Natal ABC Motsepe League champions.

nodes.name: Premier League
nodes.desc: Najvyššia kenská súťaž — 18 klubov vrátane Gor Mahia, AFC Leopards a Tusker FC.
nodes.desc_en: Top Kenyan league — 18 clubs including Gor Mahia, AFC Leopards and Tusker FC.

nodes.name: Gor Mahia
nodes.desc: Klub z Nairobi s rekordným počtom kenských ligových titulov, prezývaný K'Ogalo.
nodes.desc_en: Nairobi club with a record number of Kenyan league titles, nicknamed K'Ogalo.

nodes.name: AFC Leopards
nodes.desc: Klub z Nairobi, tretí najúspešnejší v histórii kenskej ligy a súper Gor Mahia v derby Mashemeji.
nodes.desc_en: Nairobi club, third most successful in Kenyan league history and Gor Mahia's rival in the Mashemeji Derby.

nodes.name: Kenya Police FC
nodes.desc: Klub kenskej polície z Nairobi, hrajúci domáce zápasy na štadióne Police Sacco.
nodes.desc_en: Kenyan police force club from Nairobi, playing home matches at Police Sacco Stadium.

nodes.name: Nairobi United
nodes.desc: Klub z Nairobi, ktorý v roku 2025 postúpil do najvyššej súťaže z National Super League.
nodes.desc_en: Nairobi club promoted to the top flight from the National Super League in 2025.

nodes.name: Shabana FC
nodes.desc: Historický klub z mesta Kisii, v roku 1988 sa predstavil v Africkom pohári víťazov pohárov.
nodes.desc_en: Historic club from Kisii, competed in the African Cup Winners' Cup in 1988.

nodes.name: Kakamega Homeboyz
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kakamega na západe Kene, domáce zápasy hrá na štadióne Bukhungu.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kakamega in western Kenya, playing home matches at Bukhungu Stadium.

nodes.name: KCB FC
nodes.desc: Futbalový klub kenskej banky KCB (Kenya Commercial Bank) so sídlom v Nairobi.
nodes.desc_en: Football club of Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB), based in Nairobi.

nodes.name: Murang'a Seal
nodes.desc: Novopostúpený klub z mesta Murang'a v centrálnej Keni.
nodes.desc_en: Newly promoted club from the town of Murang'a in central Kenya.

nodes.name: Tusker FC
nodes.desc: Klub pivovarníckej spoločnosti East African Breweries so sídlom v Ruaraka, prezývaný Brewers.
nodes.desc_en: Club of the East African Breweries company based in Ruaraka, nicknamed the Brewers.

nodes.name: APS Bomet
nodes.desc: Bomet — klub spojený s Administration Police; vyhral National Super League 2021/22 (postupy vtedy zrušili) a do Premier League postúpil v roku 2025.
nodes.desc_en: Bomet — club linked to the Administration Police; won the 2021/22 National Super League (promotions were later cancelled) and reached the Premier League in 2025.

nodes.name: Mara Sugar FC
nodes.desc: Klub cukrovarníckej spoločnosti Transmara Sugar z oblasti Mara.
nodes.desc_en: Club of the Transmara Sugar company from the Mara region.

nodes.name: Bandari FC
nodes.desc: Klub prístavného mesta Mombasa, prezývaný Dockers.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the port city of Mombasa, nicknamed the Dockers.

nodes.name: Ulinzi Stars
nodes.desc: Klub kenskej armády (Kenya Defence Forces) so sídlom v Nairobi.
nodes.desc_en: Club of the Kenya Defence Forces, based in Nairobi.

nodes.name: Mathare United
nodes.desc: Klub zo slumu Mathare v Nairobi, prezývaný Slum Boys.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the Mathare slum in Nairobi, nicknamed the Slum Boys.

nodes.name: Posta Rangers
nodes.desc: Klub kenskej poštovej spoločnosti (Posta Kenya) so sídlom v Nairobi.
nodes.desc_en: Club of the Kenyan postal company (Posta Kenya), based in Nairobi.

nodes.name: Ligue 1 (Linafoot)
nodes.desc: Najvyššia súťaž Demokratickej republiky Kongo — 25 klubov sezóny 2026/27 v dvoch skupinách na čele s TP Mazembe, AS Vita Club a FC Saint-Éloi Lupopo.
nodes.desc_en: Top league of the Democratic Republic of the Congo — the 25 clubs of the 2026/27 season in two groups, led by TP Mazembe, AS Vita Club and FC Saint-Éloi Lupopo.

nodes.name: TP Mazembe
nodes.desc: Klub z Lubumbashi, najúspešnejší v histórii krajiny s rekordným počtom titulov, prezývaný Corbeaux (Havrani).
nodes.desc_en: Club from Lubumbashi, the most successful in the country's history with a record number of titles, nicknamed the Corbeaux (Ravens).

nodes.name: Saint-Éloi Lupopo
nodes.desc: Klub z Lubumbashi založený v roku 1939, dlhoročný rival TP Mazembe.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Lubumbashi founded in 1939, a long-standing rival of TP Mazembe.

nodes.name: CS Don Bosco
nodes.desc: Klub z Lubumbashi založený saleziánmi, majster ligy z roku 2012.
nodes.desc_en: Lubumbashi club founded by the Salesians, league champions in 2012.

nodes.name: AS Simba
nodes.desc: Klub z ťažobného mesta Kolwezi, založený v roku 2002.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the mining town of Kolwezi, founded in 2002.

nodes.name: Blessing FC
nodes.desc: Klub z Kolwezi v provincii Lualaba, domáce zápasy hrá na štadióne Manika.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kolwezi in Lualaba province, playing home matches at Manika Stadium.

nodes.name: Lubumbashi Sport
nodes.desc: Klub z Lubumbashi založený v roku 1929, prezývaný Kamikazes.
nodes.desc_en: Lubumbashi club founded in 1929, nicknamed the Kamikazes.

nodes.name: CS Manika
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kolwezi, súper AS Simba v miestnom derby.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kolwezi, AS Simba's rival in the local derby.

nodes.name: AS Saint-Luc
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kananga, založený belgickým katolíckym kňazom v roku 1992.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kananga, founded by a Belgian Catholic priest in 1992.

nodes.name: FC Tanganyika
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kalemie pri jazere Tanganyika na východe krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the town of Kalemie by Lake Tanganyika in the east of the country.

nodes.name: Sanga Balende
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Mbuji-Mayi založený v roku 1962.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Mbuji-Mayi, founded in 1962.

nodes.name: AS New Soger
nodes.desc: Klub z Lubumbashi, ktorý v minulosti prevzal licenciu klubu AC Kuya.
nodes.desc_en: Lubumbashi club that took over the license of AC Kuya in the past.

nodes.name: AS Malole
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kananga, mestský majster z roku 2015.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kananga, city champions in 2015.

nodes.name: AS Vita Club
nodes.desc: Klub z Kinshasy, jeden z najúspešnejších v histórii krajiny, prezývaný Les Dauphins Noirs.
nodes.desc_en: Kinshasa club, one of the country's most successful, nicknamed Les Dauphins Noirs.

nodes.name: Aigles du Congo
nodes.desc: Klub z Kinshasy založený v roku 2023, prvý titul majstra krajiny získal hneď v sezóne 2024/25.
nodes.desc_en: Kinshasa club founded in 2023, won its first national title in the very 2024/25 season.

nodes.name: AS Maniema Union
nodes.desc: Kindu — klub založený v roku 2005, víťaz Konžského pohára 2007, 2017 a 2019; v sezóne 2024/25 hral skupinovú fázu Ligy majstrov CAF.
nodes.desc_en: Kindu — club founded in 2005, Coupe du Congo winners in 2007, 2017 and 2019; reached the CAF Champions League group stage in 2024/25.

nodes.name: AS Dauphins Noirs
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Goma na východe krajiny, založený v roku 2002.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Goma in the east of the country, founded in 2002.

nodes.name: Céleste FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Mbandaka, hlavného mesta provincie Ekvátor.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Mbandaka, capital of Équateur province.

nodes.name: AC Rangers
nodes.desc: Klub z Kinshasy založený v roku 2000, prezývaný Les Académiciens.
nodes.desc_en: Kinshasa club founded in 2000, nicknamed Les Académiciens.

nodes.name: FC Étoile du Kivu
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Bukavu na východe krajiny, založený v roku 2016.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Bukavu in the east of the country, founded in 2016.

nodes.name: New JAK
nodes.desc: Kinshasa — klub New JAK, ktorý hrá domáce zápasy na Stade Tata Raphaël; v sezóne 2025/26 účastník skupiny B Linafoot.
nodes.desc_en: Kinshasa — New JAK, a club playing its home games at the Stade Tata Raphaël; competed in Group B of Linafoot in 2025/26.

nodes.name: FC MK Étanchéité
nodes.desc: Klub z Kinshasy založený v roku 1995, víťaz Konžského pohára z roku 2014.
nodes.desc_en: Kinshasa club founded in 1995, winners of the Congo Cup in 2014.

nodes.name: AF Ufalya Simba
nodes.desc: Klub z Kinshasy hrajúci v najvyššej súťaži krajiny, do roku 2026 známy ako AF Anges Verts.
nodes.desc_en: Kinshasa club playing in the country's top division, known as AF Anges Verts until 2026.

nodes.name: Premier League
nodes.desc: Najvyššia súťaž Lesotha — 16 klubov vrátane Bantu FC, Matlama FC a Lioli FC.
nodes.desc_en: Top league of Lesotho — 16 clubs including Bantu FC, Matlama FC and Lioli FC.

nodes.name: Lijabatho FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Morija, prvýkrát v histórii vyhral titul majstra Lesotha v sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Morija, won the Lesotho title for the first time in club history in the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: Lifofane FC
nodes.desc: Butha-Buthe — klub hrajúci v Premier League od roku 2019; v sezóne 2025/26 skončil druhý a postúpil do Konfederačného pohára CAF 2026/27.
nodes.desc_en: Butha-Buthe — club playing in the Premier League since 2019; finished runners-up in 2025/26 to qualify for the 2026/27 CAF Confederation Cup.

nodes.name: Bantu FC
nodes.desc: Mafeteng — klub založený v roku 1927, prezývaný „A Mats'o Matebele“; päťnásobný majster Lesotha (2014, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2022/23) a osemnásobný víťaz Independence Cupu.
nodes.desc_en: Mafeteng — club founded in 1927, nicknamed "A Mats'o Matebele"; five-time Lesotho champions (2014, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2022/23) and eight-time Independence Cup winners.

nodes.name: Matlama FC
nodes.desc: Klub z hlavného mesta Maseru, jeden z tradičných klubov krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the capital Maseru, one of the country's traditional clubs.

nodes.name: Majantja FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Mohale's Hoek, založený v roku 1932.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Mohale's Hoek, founded in 1932.

nodes.name: Lesotho Defence Force FC
nodes.desc: Futbalový klub lesothskej armády, hrá na štadióne Ratjomose.
nodes.desc_en: Football club of the Lesotho Defence Force, playing at Ratjomose Stadium.

nodes.name: Lioli FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Teyateyaneng, rekordný majster krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Teyateyaneng, a record title-holder in the country.

nodes.name: Linare FC
nodes.desc: Klub z okresu Leribe, založený v roku 1931.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Leribe district, founded in 1931.

nodes.name: Lesotho Correctional Services FC
nodes.desc: Futbalový klub lesothskej väzenskej služby, viacnásobný majster krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Football club of the Lesotho Correctional Service, a multiple national champion.

nodes.name: Lesotho Mounted Police Service FC
nodes.desc: Futbalový klub lesothskej jazdnej polície, prezývaný Simunye.
nodes.desc_en: Football club of the Lesotho Mounted Police Service, nicknamed Simunye.

nodes.name: Manonyane FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Roma, založený v roku 1986.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Roma, founded in 1986.

nodes.name: Machokha FC
nodes.desc: Lesotho — klub, ktorý do Premier League postúpil v roku 2022.
nodes.desc_en: Lesotho — club promoted to the Premier League in 2022.

nodes.name: Limkokwing University FC
nodes.desc: Futbalový klub Univerzity Limkokwing, vznikol v roku 2015.
nodes.desc_en: Football club of Limkokwing University, formed in 2015.

nodes.name: Members FC
nodes.desc: Klub z hlavného mesta Maseru, hrajúci v najvyššej súťaži.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the capital Maseru, playing in the top division.

nodes.name: Elite One
nodes.desc: Najvyššia kamerunská súťaž — 14 klubov vrátane Coton Sport de Garoua, Canon Yaoundé a PWD Bamenda.
nodes.desc_en: Top Cameroonian league — 14 clubs including Coton Sport de Garoua, Canon Yaoundé and PWD Bamenda.

nodes.name: Elite Two
nodes.desc: Druhá kamerunská liga — 12 klubov bojujúcich o postup do Elite One, vrátane AS FAP a Tonnerre Yaoundé.
nodes.desc_en: Second Cameroonian tier — 12 clubs fighting for promotion to Elite One, including AS FAP and Tonnerre Yaoundé.

nodes.name: Colombe Sportive
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Sangmélima, obhajca titulu, majster Kamerunu 2025 aj 2026.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Sangmélima, defending champions, Cameroon champions in both 2025 and 2026.

nodes.name: Dynamo Douala
nodes.desc: Klub z Doualy založený v roku 1948, prezývaný Bon Ba Job (Deti Božie).
nodes.desc_en: Club from Douala founded in 1948, nicknamed Bon Ba Job (Children of God).

nodes.name: Unisport de Bafang
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Bafang, prezývaný Flambeau de l'Ouest.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Bafang, nicknamed Flambeau de l'Ouest.

nodes.name: Coton Sport de Garoua
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Garoua, viacnásobný majster Kamerunu.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Garoua, a multiple Cameroon champion.

nodes.name: Canon Yaoundé
nodes.desc: Klub z hlavného mesta Yaoundé, víťaz troch afrických Ligy majstrov.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the capital Yaoundé, three-time winner of the African Champions' Cup.

nodes.name: Panthère du Ndé
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Bangangté, založený v roku 1952.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Bangangté, founded in 1952.

nodes.name: PWD Bamenda
nodes.desc: Najstarší klub Kamerunu, založený v roku 1962 v meste Bamenda.
nodes.desc_en: The oldest club in Cameroon, founded in 1962 in Bamenda.

nodes.name: Victoria United
nodes.desc: Limbe — klub založený v roku 2002, prezývaný „Opopo“; v roku 2023 postúpil z Elite Two, v sezóne 2023/24 získal titul Elite One a v roku 2024 hral Ligu majstrov CAF.
nodes.desc_en: Limbe — club founded in 2002, nicknamed "Opopo"; promoted from Elite Two in 2023, won the Elite One title in 2023/24 and played in the CAF Champions League in 2024.

nodes.name: Gazelle FA
nodes.desc: Futbalová akadémia z mesta Garoua na severe krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Football academy from Garoua in the north of the country.

nodes.name: Stade Renard
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Melong, postúpil do Elite One v roku 2017.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Melong, promoted to Elite One in 2017.

nodes.name: Aigle Royal du Moungo
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Nkongsamba, majster Kamerunu z roku 1971.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Nkongsamba, Cameroon champions in 1971.

nodes.name: Aigle Royal Menoua
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Dschang, založený v roku 1932, do Elite One postúpil v sezóne 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Dschang, founded in 1932, promoted to Elite One for the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: AS Fortuna Mfou
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Mfou, založený v roku 1998.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Mfou, founded in 1998.

nodes.name: Fauve Azur Elite
nodes.desc: Klub z hlavného mesta Yaoundé, založený v roku 2015.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the capital Yaoundé, founded in 2015.

nodes.name: APEJES FC de Mfou
nodes.desc: Futbalová akadémia z mesta Mfou, založená v roku 2006.

nodes.desc: Klub zo štvrtého obvodu Bamaka, ktorý sa v posledných sezónach drží v hornej polovici tabuľky — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Bamako's fourth commune that has stayed in the top half of the table in recent seasons; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Binga FC
nodes.desc: Mladý malijský klub, ktorý sa rýchlo etabloval v najvyššej súťaži — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Young Malian club that has quickly established itself in the top flight; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: USFAS Bamako
nodes.desc: Klub malijských ozbrojených síl so sídlom v Bamaku — nemá overiteľnú oficiálnu stránku ani sociálnu sieť, odkaz vedie na jeho profil vo futbalovej databáze.
nodes.desc_en: Club of the Malian armed forces, based in Bamako — it has no verifiable official website or social media, so the link leads to its football database profile.

nodes.name: AS Korofina
nodes.desc: Klub z bamackej štvrte Korofina, v tabuľkách často uvádzaný ako ASKO — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Bamako's Korofina district, often listed in tables as ASKO; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: US Bougouba
nodes.desc: Klub z obce Bougouba, jeden z mála prvoligistov mimo hlavného mesta — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the town of Bougouba, one of the few top-flight sides from outside the capital; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Derby Académie
nodes.desc: Bamacká futbalová akadémia, ktorá si vlastnou mládežou vybojovala miesto medzi malijskou elitou — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Bamako football academy that has earned a place among the Malian elite with its own youth products; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: AS Bakaridjan
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Barouéli v regióne Ségou, ktorý si drží prvoligovú príslušnosť od roku 2005 — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the town of Baroueli in the Ségou region, in the top flight since 2005; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Afrique Football Elite
nodes.desc: Bamacká akadémia zameraná na výchovu mladých hráčov — odkaz vedie na profil klubu na Sofascore.
nodes.desc_en: Bamako academy focused on developing young players; the link leads to the club's Sofascore profile.

nodes.name: Onze Créateurs de Niaréla
nodes.desc: Klub z bamackej štvrte Niaréla s bohatou minulosťou v malijskom pohári — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Bamako's Niaréla district with a rich Malian Cup history; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: FC Mali Coura
nodes.desc: Klub zo Samanyany, ktorý po sezóne 2025/26 zostúpil — nemá overiteľnú oficiálnu stránku, odkaz vedie na jeho profil vo futbalovej databáze.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Samanyana, relegated after the 2025/26 season — it has no verifiable official page, so the link leads to its football database profile.

nodes.name: US Bougouni
nodes.desc: Klub z juhomalijského mesta Bougouni, ktorý po sezóne 2025/26 zostúpil — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the southern Malian town of Bougouni, relegated after the 2025/26 season; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Botola Pro 1
nodes.desc: Najvyššia marocká súťaž — 16 klubov vrátane Rajy Casablanca, Wydadu AC a AS FAR.
nodes.desc_en: Top Moroccan league — 16 clubs including Raja Casablanca, Wydad AC and AS FAR.

nodes.name: Botola Pro 2
nodes.desc: Druhá marocká liga — 16 klubov bojujúcich o postup medzi elitu, vrátane KAC Kenitra a Olympic Safi.
nodes.desc_en: Second Moroccan tier — 16 clubs fighting for promotion to the top flight, including KAC Kenitra and Olympic Safi.

nodes.name: Maghreb Fes (MAS)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Fez, aktualny majster Maroka (2025/26) a rekordny drzitel styroch titulov D2.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Fez, the reigning Moroccan champions (2025/26) and a four-time Botola Pro 2 record winner.

nodes.name: RS Berkane
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Berkane, trojnasobny vitaz africkeho Konfederacneho pohara CAF.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Berkane, a three-time winner of the CAF Confederation Cup.

nodes.name: Raja Casablanca
nodes.desc: Klub z Casablanky prezyvany Zeleni orli, jeden z najpopularnejsich futbalovych klubov v Afrike.
nodes.desc_en: Casablanca club nicknamed the Green Eagles, one of the most popular football clubs in Africa.

nodes.name: AS FAR
nodes.desc: Klub Krajovskej armady z Rabatu, v sezone 2025/26 hral finale africkej Ligy majstrov.
nodes.desc_en: Royal Armed Forces club from Rabat, reached the 2025/26 CAF Champions League final.

nodes.name: Wydad AC
nodes.desc: Klub z Casablanky, najtitulovanejsi tim Maroka s 22 majstrovskymi titulmi a tromi africkymi Ligami majstrov.
nodes.desc_en: Casablanca club, Morocco's most decorated team with 22 league titles and three CAF Champions League trophies.

nodes.name: Difaa El Jadida (DHJ)
nodes.desc: Klub z pristavneho mesta El Jadida, stabilny ucastnik najvyssej marockej sutaze.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the port city of El Jadida, a stable member of Morocco's top division.

nodes.name: IR Tanger
nodes.desc: Klub z Tangeru, v sezone 2025/26 zaznamenal historicky uspech pod prezyvkou Kings of the North.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Tangier, enjoyed a historic 2025/26 season under the nickname Kings of the North.

nodes.name: FUS Rabat
nodes.desc: Viacsportovy klub z Rabatu, jeho futbalovy tim hraval aj africku Ligu majstrov.
nodes.desc_en: Multi-sport club from Rabat whose football team has also played in the CAF Champions League.

nodes.name: Kawkab Marrakech (KACM)
nodes.desc: Klub z Marrakeša, do najvyssej ligy sa vratil po postupe z Botoly 2 v sezone 2024/25.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Marrakech, returned to the top flight after promotion from Botola Pro 2 in 2024/25.

nodes.name: COD Meknes
nodes.desc: Viacsportovy klub z Meknesu, vznikol v roku 1962 zlucenim styroch miestnych timov.
nodes.desc_en: Multi-sport club from Meknes, formed in 1962 through the merger of four local teams.

nodes.name: Renaissance Zemamra (RCAZ)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Zemamra, v najvyssej lige hra od sezony 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Zemamra, competing in the top division since the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: Hassania Agadir (HUSA)
nodes.desc: Klub zo pristavneho mesta Agadir, zalozeny v roku 1946 odbojnou skupinou proti francuzskej kolonizacii.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the port city of Agadir, founded in 1946 by a group resisting French colonial rule.

nodes.name: Union Touarga (UTS)
nodes.desc: Klub ze stvrte Touarga v Rabate, vznikol v roku 1971 zlucenim siedmich miestnych timov.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the Touarga district of Rabat, formed in 1971 through the merger of seven local teams.

nodes.name: Olympique Dcheira
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Dcheira pri Agadire, do najvyssej marockej ligy postupil vubec prvykrat v sezone 2024/25.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Dcheira near Agadir, achieved its first-ever promotion to Morocco's top flight in 2024/25.

nodes.name: US Yacoub El Mansour (USYM)
nodes.desc: Klub ze stvrte Yacoub El Mansour v Rabate, v najvyssej lige debutoval v sezone 2025/26.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Rabat's Yacoub El Mansour district, made its top-flight debut in the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: Olympic Club Safi (OCS)
nodes.desc: Klub z pristavneho mesta Safi prezyvany Zraloky, jeden z najstarsich marockych klubov (zalozeny 1921).
nodes.desc_en: Club from the port city of Safi nicknamed the Sharks, one of Morocco's oldest clubs, founded in 1921.

nodes.name: Moghreb Tetouan (MAT)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Tetouan, v sezone 2025/26 vyhral Botolu 2 a postupil do najvyssej ligy.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Tetouan, won Botola Pro 2 in 2025/26 and earned promotion to the top division.

nodes.name: Wydad Sportif Temara (WST)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Temara, zalozeny v roku 1993 miestnymi priaznivcami Wydadu Casablanca.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Temara, founded in 1993 by local supporters of Wydad Casablanca.

nodes.name: US Amal Tiznit
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Tiznit na juhu Maroka, zalozeny v roku 1948.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the southern Moroccan town of Tiznit, founded in 1948.

nodes.name: Jeunesse Massira
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Laayoune v Zapadnej Sahare, zalozeny v roku 1977.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Laayoune in Western Sahara, founded in 1977.

nodes.name: Chabab Atlas Khenifra (CAK)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Khenifra v pohori Stredny Atlas, podla ktoreho nesie svoj nazov.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Khenifra in the Middle Atlas mountains, after which it is named.

nodes.name: Jeunesse Soualem (JSS)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Had Soualem, zalozeny v roku 1984.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Had Soualem, founded in 1984.

nodes.name: Stade Marocain
nodes.desc: Viacsportovy klub z Rabatu zalozeny v roku 1919, jeden z vobec najstarsich marockych klubov.
nodes.desc_en: Multi-sport club from Rabat founded in 1919, one of the very oldest Moroccan clubs.

nodes.name: Wydad Fes (WAF)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Fez zalozeny v roku 1948, ktoreho zakladatelia zvolili bielo-cierne farby ako symbol proti rasizmu.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Fez founded in 1948, whose founders chose black and white colours as a symbol against racism.

nodes.name: Mouloudia Oujda (MCO)
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Oujda na severovychode Maroka, drzitel jedneho ligoveho titulu a styroch Pohar trony.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Oujda in north-eastern Morocco, winner of one league title and four Throne Cups.

nodes.name: Chabab Benguerir (CJBG)
nodes.desc: Klub z banickeho mesta Benguerir, zalozeny v roku 1952.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the mining town of Benguerir, founded in 1952.

nodes.name: USM Oujda
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Oujda, vznikol v roku 1958 zlucenim styroch miestnych timov.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Oujda, formed in 1958 through the merger of four local teams.

nodes.name: SCC Mohammedia
nodes.desc: Viacsportovy klub z pristavneho mesta Mohammedia, zalozeny v roku 1948.
nodes.desc_en: Multi-sport club from the port city of Mohammedia, founded in 1948.

nodes.name: KAC Kenitra
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kenitra zalozeny v roku 1938, jeden z historicky vyznamnych marockych klubov.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Kenitra founded in 1938, one of Morocco's historically significant clubs.

nodes.name: US Boujaad
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Boujaad v provincii Khouribga, zalozeny v roku 1946.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Boujaad in Khouribga province, founded in 1946.

nodes.name: National Super League
nodes.desc: Najvyššia maurícijská súťaž — 10 klubov vrátane Pamplemousses SC, Cercle de Joachim SC a AS Port-Louis 2000.
nodes.desc_en: Top Mauritian league — 10 clubs including Pamplemousses SC, Cercle de Joachim SC and AS Port-Louis 2000.

nodes.name: La Cure Waves SC
nodes.desc: Klub z Port Louis, v sezone 2025/26 ziskal svoj vobec prvy titul majstra Mauricia.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Port Louis, won its first-ever Mauritian championship title in the 2025/26 season.

nodes.name: Pamplemousses SC
nodes.desc: Klub z okresu Pamplemousses, drzitel dvoch majstrovskych titulov (2017/18, 2018/19).
nodes.desc_en: Club from Pamplemousses district, a two-time Mauritian champion (2017/18, 2018/19).

nodes.name: Chebel Citizens SC
nodes.desc: Klub hrajuci najvyssiu mauricijsku sutaz, National Super League.
nodes.desc_en: Club competing in Mauritius's top flight, the National Super League.

nodes.name: Cercle de Joachim SC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Curepipe, štvornásobný majster Maurícia (naposledy 2024/25).
nodes.desc_en: Club from Curepipe, four-time Mauritian champions (most recently in 2024/25).

nodes.name: AS Riviere du Rempart
nodes.desc: Klub z okresu Riviere du Rempart na severe ostrova.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the Rivière du Rempart district in the north of the island.

nodes.name: AS Port-Louis 2000
nodes.desc: Klub z hlavneho mesta Port Louis prezyvany Musketieri, sestnasobny majster Mauricia.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the capital Port Louis nicknamed the Musketeers, a six-time Mauritian champion.

nodes.desc_en: Bambous (Black River district) — club founded in 1998, Mauritian Cup winners in 2007, 2014 and 2015; plays at the Stade Germain Comarmond.

nodes.name: AS Vacoas-Phoenix

nodes.desc_en: Vacoas-Phoenix — club founded in 2000, Mauritian Cup winners in 2010; plays home games at the Stade George V in Curepipe.

nodes.name: US Beau-Bassin/Rose-Hill
nodes.desc: Beau Bassin-Rose Hill — klub založený v roku 2000, víťaz Pohára Maurícia 2001; v sezóne 2018/19 vyhral druhú ligu, hrá na štadióne Sir Gaëtan Duval.
nodes.desc_en: Beau Bassin-Rose Hill — club founded in 2000, Mauritian Cup winners in 2001; won the second division in 2018/19 and play at the Sir Gaëtan Duval Stadium.

nodes.name: Pointe-aux-Sables Mates
nodes.desc: Klub zo stvrte Pointe-aux-Sables pri Port Louis, v roku 2006 hral africky Konfederacny pohar.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the Pointe-aux-Sables area near Port Louis, played in the 2006 CAF Confederation Cup.

nodes.name: Ligue 1

nodes.desc_en: Top Mauritanian league — 14 clubs led by FC Nouadhibou and FC Tevragh-Zeina.

nodes.name: FC Nouadhibou

nodes.name: Nzeidane
nodes.desc: Klub hrajuci najvyssiu mauretansku futbalovu sutaz Ligue 1.
nodes.desc_en: Club competing in Mauritania's top football division, Ligue 1.

nodes.desc_en: Nouakchott — the fire brigade's club (AS Pompier); finished 8th in the Super D1 in 2024/25 and 4th in 2025/26.

nodes.name: Nouakchott Academy
nodes.desc: Nouakchott — v auguste 2025 vyhral postupový turnaj Super D2 (vo finále 3:2 nad ASC Police) a v debutovej sezóne 2025/26 v Super D1 skončil piaty.
nodes.desc_en: Nouakchott — won the Super D2 promotion tournament in August 2025 (3–2 over ASC Police in the final) and finished 5th in its debut 2025/26 Super D1 season.

nodes.name: ASC Gendrim
nodes.desc: Klub so sidlom v Nouakchotte, hraci na Stade Cheikha Ould Boidiya.
nodes.desc_en: Club based in Nouakchott, playing at Stade Cheikha Ould Boïdiya.

nodes.name: Chemal FC
nodes.desc: Klub hrajuci najvyssiu mauretansku futbalovu sutaz Ligue 1.
nodes.desc_en: Club competing in Mauritania's top football division, Ligue 1.

nodes.name: Nouakchott King's
nodes.desc: Nouakchott — klub založený v roku 1997 ako ASC Nasr Teyarett; v ročníku 2018/19 hral Konfederačný pohár CAF, domáce zápasy hrá na Olympijskom štadióne.
nodes.desc_en: Nouakchott — club founded in 1997 as ASC Nasr Teyarett; played in the 2018–19 CAF Confederation Cup and plays home games at the Olympic Stadium.

nodes.name: ASC SNIM
nodes.desc: Klub tazobnej spolocnosti SNIM z pristavneho mesta Nouadhibou.
nodes.desc_en: Club of the SNIM mining company from the port city of Nouadhibou.

nodes.name: FC Tevragh-Zeina
nodes.desc: Klub zo stvrte Tevragh-Zeina v hlavnom meste Nouakchott.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the Tevragh-Zeina district of the capital Nouakchott.

nodes.name: ASC Police
nodes.desc: Policajny klub z Nouakchottu, sedemnasobny majster Mauretanie (naposledy v roku 1991).
nodes.desc_en: Police club from Nouakchott, a seven-time Mauritanian champion (last in 1991).

nodes.name: Kaedi FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Kaedi na juhu krajiny pri hranici so Senegalom.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the town of Kaédi in the south of the country, near the border with Senegal.

nodes.name: Mocambola
nodes.desc: Najvyššia mozambická súťaž — 14 klubov vrátane Costa do Sol, UD Songo a Black Bulls.
nodes.desc_en: Top Mozambican league — 14 clubs including Costa do Sol, UD Songo and Black Bulls.

nodes.name: Ferroviario Beira
nodes.desc: Klub z pristavneho mesta Beira, zalozeny v roku 1924.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the port city of Beira, founded in 1924.

nodes.name: UD Songo
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Songo pri priehrade Cahora Bassa, trojnasobny majster Mozambiku (2017, 2018, 2022, naposledy 2025).
nodes.desc_en: Club from Songo near the Cahora Bassa dam, a four-time Mozambican champion (2017, 2018, 2022, most recently 2025).

nodes.name: Black Bulls
nodes.desc: Klub z Maputa zalozeny v roku 2017, majster Mozambiku v rokoch 2021 a 2024.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Maputo founded in 2017, Mozambican champion in 2021 and 2024.

nodes.name: Costa do Sol
nodes.desc: Klub z hlavneho mesta Maputo, desatnasobny majster Mozambiku.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the capital Maputo, a ten-time Mozambican champion.

nodes.name: Ferroviario Lichinga
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Lichinga na severe krajiny, zalozeny v roku 1924.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Lichinga in the north of the country, founded in 1924.

nodes.name: Ferroviario Nampula
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Nampula, zalozeny v roku 1924.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Nampula, founded in 1924.

nodes.name: Liga Desportiva de Sofala
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Beira, do najvyssej sutaze postupil v sezone 2026 za centralnu zonu krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Beira, promoted to the top flight for the 2026 season representing the country's central zone.

nodes.name: Ferroviario Nacala
nodes.desc: Klub z pristavneho mesta Nacala na severovychode krajiny.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the north-eastern port city of Nacala.

nodes.name: Ferroviario Maputo
nodes.desc: Maputo — klub založený v roku 1924 ako Ferroviário de Lourenço Marques; desaťnásobný majster Moçambola (naposledy 2015) a víťaz Taça de Moçambique 2024.
nodes.desc_en: Maputo — club founded in 1924 as Ferroviário de Lourenço Marques; ten-time Moçambola champions (most recently in 2015) and Taça de Moçambique winners in 2024.

nodes.name: ENH Vilankulo
nodes.desc: Klub z pobrezneho mesta Vilankulo, povodne zalozeny pri statnej ropnej spolocnosti ENH.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the coastal town of Vilankulo, originally founded within the state oil company ENH.

nodes.name: AD Pemba

nodes.desc_en: Club from the northern port city of Pemba, founded in 1939, returned to Moçambola in 2026 after 35 years away.

nodes.name: Baia de Pemba FC
nodes.desc: Pemba — klub, ktorý do Moçambola postúpil v roku 2023 a v debutovej sezóne skončil šiesty; v najvyššej súťaži hrá aj v roku 2026.
nodes.desc_en: Pemba — promoted to the Moçambola in 2023 and finished 6th in its debut season; still in the top flight in 2026.

nodes.name: Chingale de Tete
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Tete na severozapade krajiny, zalozeny v roku 1936.
nodes.desc_en: Club from Tete in the north-west of the country, founded in 1936.

nodes.name: Maxaquene
nodes.desc: Viacsportovy klub z hlavneho mesta Maputo, zalozeny v roku 1920.
nodes.desc_en: Multi-sport club from the capital Maputo, founded in 1920.

nodes.name: Super Ligue

nodes.desc_en: Top Nigerien league — 16 clubs including Sahel SC, AS FAN and ASN Nigelec.

nodes.desc_en: Club of the state electricity company based in Niamey, reigning champions of Niger for the 2025/26 season; the link leads to the ASNN-Nigelec team Facebook page.

nodes.desc: Vojenský klub žandárstva z Niamey, ktorý v roku 2021 získal svoj historicky prvý titul aj pohár — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Military gendarmerie club from Niamey that won its first-ever league and cup double in 2021; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: AS FAN
nodes.desc: Klub nigerských ozbrojených síl z Niamey, 6-násobný majster krajiny a jediný nigerský tím s kontinentálnou trofejou (Pohár UFOA 1996).
nodes.desc_en: Club of the Nigerien Armed Forces based in Niamey, six-time national champions and the only Nigerien club to have won a continental trophy (1996 UFOA Cup).

nodes.name: AS Police
nodes.desc: Klub národnej polície z Niamey, ktorý v roku 2008 získal double – titul aj pohár — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: National police club from Niamey that won the league and cup double in 2008; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: AS GNN
nodes.desc: Klub Národnej gardy z Niamey, viacnásobný víťaz Nigerského pohára, naposledy v rokoch 2023 a 2024 — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: National Guard club from Niamey, a multiple winner of the Niger Cup, most recently in 2023 and 2024; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: AS Douanes
nodes.desc: Klub colnej správy z Niamey, majster ligy z roku 2013 a dvojnásobný víťaz pohára — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Customs authority club from Niamey, league champions in 2013 and two-time cup winners; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Espoir FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Zinder, jeden z mála popredných tímov mimo hlavného mesta Niamey — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the city of Zinder, one of the few leading teams based outside the capital Niamey; the link leads to the official Facebook page.

nodes.name: JS Tahoua FC
nodes.desc: Klub z mesta Tahoua, ktorý v roku 2009 postúpil do skupinovej fázy Africkej ligy majstrov — odkaz vedie na oficiálny Facebook klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Club from the city of Tahoua that reached the group stage of the CAF Champions League in 2009; the link leads to the club's official Facebook page.
