nodes.desc_en: Beninese volleyball clubs — the men’s top division, the Championnat Professionnel; 10 of the 17 clubs of the 2025/26 season are included. The women’s league is not included. Clubs: Beninese Men’s Volleyball League — Adjidja VBC, Allada Olympics, Béké VBC, Finances VBC.

nodes.name: Líbya
nodes.desc: Líbyjské volejbalové kluby — najvyššia mužská liga so 14 klubmi. Ženská liga v Líbyi neexistuje. Kluby: Líbyjská liga mužov — Al-Ittihad Tripoli, Al-Ahly Benghazi, Al-Ahly Tripoli, Al-Swihli.
nodes.desc_en: Libyan volleyball clubs — the men’s top division with 14 clubs. There is no women’s league in Libya. Clubs: Libyan Men’s Volleyball League — Al-Ittihad Tripoli, Al-Ahly Benghazi, Al-Ahly Tripoli, Al-Swihli.

nodes.name: Tanzánia
nodes.desc: Tanzánijské volejbalové kluby — najvyššia mužská súťaž Tanzania Volleyball National League (TVNL); zaradených je 11 z jej 14 klubov. Ženská liga zaradená nie je. Kluby: Tanzánijská liga mužov — KIUT, High Voltage, Jeshi Stars, Bandari.
nodes.desc_en: Tanzanian volleyball clubs — the men’s top competition, the Tanzania Volleyball National League (TVNL); 11 of its 14 clubs are included. The women’s league is not included. Clubs: Tanzanian Men’s Volleyball League — KIUT, High Voltage, Jeshi Stars, Bandari.

nodes.name: Egyptská liga mužov

nodes.desc_en: Egypt’s top men’s volleyball competition, the Premier League (ad-Dawri al-Mumtaz) — 24 clubs in four groups in 2026/27, starting on 29 September 2026; Al Ahly are the 2025/26 champions.

nodes.name: Egyptská liga žien
nodes.desc: Najvyššia egyptská ženská volejbalová súťaž — v sezóne 2026/27 ju hrá 16 klubov v štyroch skupinách; majstrom sezóny 2025/26 je Al Ahly. Medzi ďalšie kluby patria Smouha, Al-Shams, Gezira a 6 October.
nodes.desc_en: Egypt’s top women’s volleyball competition — 16 clubs in four groups in 2026/27; Al Ahly are the 2025/26 champions. Other clubs include Smouha, Al-Shams, Gezira and 6 October.

nodes.name: 6 October

nodes.desc_en: Sixth of October City in Giza Governorate — the club was founded in 1984. It has no website covering volleyball, so the link goes to the club’s official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Al Ahly
nodes.desc: Káhira — najúspešnejší egyptský volejbalový klub, založený v roku 1932, získal titul aj v sezónach 2023/24, 2024/25 a 2025/26. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú rubriku oficiálneho webu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — Egypt’s most successful volleyball club, founded in 1932, also won the title in 2023/24, 2024/25 and 2025/26. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Al-Ittihad Alexandria
nodes.desc: Alexandria — klub založený v roku 1914 skončil v sezóne 2021/22 v lige druhý. Jeho vlastný web je rozbitý, odkaz preto vedie na oficiálnu facebookovú stránku klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Alexandria — founded in 1914, the club finished second in the 2021/22 league. Its own website is broken, so the link goes to the club’s official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Al-Shams
nodes.desc: Káhira — odkaz vedie na volejbalovú rubriku oficiálneho webu klubu, kde vychádzajú správy o mužských aj ženských tímoch.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website, which covers both the men’s and the women’s teams.

nodes.name: Al-Shorta
nodes.desc: Káhira — klub egyptskej polície, ktorý vo volejbale vystupuje aj pod menom Ittihád aš-Šurta. Vlastný web ani živú sociálnu sieť sa nájsť nepodarilo, odkaz preto vedie na profil tímu v databáze Volleybox.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the Egyptian police club, which also appears in volleyball as Ittihad El Shorta. Neither a website of its own nor a live social network could be found, so the link goes to the team’s profile in the Volleybox database.

nodes.name: Al-Tayaran
nodes.desc: Káhira — klub egyptského letectva (Aviation Club) skončil v sezóne 2016/17 v lige tretí. Odkaz vedie na oficiálnu facebookovú stránku klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the Egyptian aviation club finished third in the 2016/17 league. The link goes to the club’s official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Al-Zohour
nodes.desc: Nasr City v Kaire — viacšportový klub, ktorého vlastný web volejbalovú sekciu nemá. Odkaz preto vedie na oficiálnu facebookovú stránku klubu so 159 tisíc sledovateľmi.
nodes.desc_en: Nasr City in Cairo — a multi-sport club whose own website has no volleyball section, so the link goes to its official Facebook page with 159,000 followers.

nodes.name: Arab Contractors
nodes.desc: Káhira — klub stavebnej spoločnosti Al-Mukáwilún al-Arab vznikol v roku 1973. Jeho vlastný web sa v prehliadači neotvorí, odkaz preto vedie na oficiálnu facebookovú stránku klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the club of the Arab Contractors construction company was founded in 1973. Its own website will not open in a browser, so the link goes to the club’s official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Canal SC
nodes.desc: Egyptský klub známy aj pod arabským menom al-Qaná. Vlastný web nemá, odkaz vedie na jeho oficiálnu facebookovú stránku, ktorá pridáva príspevky denne.
nodes.desc_en: An Egyptian club also known by its Arabic name El Qanah. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page, which posts daily.

nodes.name: Delphi
nodes.desc: Alexandria — klub vznikol v roku 2000. Vlastný web nemá, odkaz vedie na jeho oficiálnu facebookovú stránku.
nodes.desc_en: Alexandria — the club was founded in 2000. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Eastern Company
nodes.desc: Káhira — klub tabakovej spoločnosti Eastern Company. Vlastný web nemá, odkaz vedie na jeho oficiálnu facebookovú stránku.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the club of the Eastern Company tobacco group. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Gezira
nodes.desc: Káhira — Gezira Sporting Club z ostrova Zamalek bol založený v roku 1882 ako Khedivial Sporting Club a je najväčším viacšportovým areálom v Egypte. Jeho facebooková stránka aj instagramový účet zmĺkli v roku 2021 a web gsc.eg je len prihlasovacia stránka pre členov, odkaz preto vedie na profil tímu v databáze Volleybox.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — Gezira Sporting Club on Zamalek island was founded in 1882 as the Khedivial Sporting Club and is the largest multi-sport facility in Egypt. Its Facebook page and Instagram account both went quiet in 2021 and gsc.eg is only a members’ login page, so the link goes to the team’s profile in the Volleybox database.

nodes.name: Helio Lido
nodes.desc: Káhira — staršia klubová facebooková stránka je od roku 2019 bez príspevku a vlastný web klub nemá, odkaz preto vedie na facebookovú stránku športových sekcií klubu Heliolido.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the older club Facebook page has had no post since 2019 and the club has no website of its own, so the link goes to the Facebook page of the Heliolido club’s sports sections.

nodes.name: Heliopolis
nodes.desc: Káhira — Heliopolis Sporting Club vznikol v roku 1910. Vlastný web venovaný volejbalu nemá, odkaz preto vedie na jeho oficiálnu facebookovú stránku.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — Heliopolis Sporting Club was founded in 1910. It has no website covering volleyball, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Misr Petroleum
nodes.desc: Al-Azbakíja v Kaire — klub ropnej spoločnosti Misr Petroleum vznikol v roku 1932 na deviatich feddánoch a má ihriská pre futbal, tenis, basketbal, hádzanú, volejbal aj plávanie. Vlastný klubový web neexistuje a firemná stránka o volejbale nepíše, odkaz preto vedie na facebookovú stránku volejbalového oddielu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Al-Azbakeya in Cairo — the club of the Misr Petroleum oil company was founded in 1932 on nine feddans and has grounds for football, tennis, basketball, handball, volleyball and swimming. There is no club website and the company page says nothing about volleyball, so the link goes to the Facebook page of the club’s volleyball section.

nodes.name: Petrojet
nodes.desc: Káhira — klub ropnej firmy Petrojet skončil v lige druhý v sezóne 2024/25 a tretí v sezóne 2025/26. Vlastný web nemá, odkaz vedie na jeho oficiálnu facebookovú stránku.
nodes.desc_en: Cairo — the club of the Petrojet oil company finished second in 2024/25 and third in 2025/26. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.desc: Montes Claros v štáte Minas Gerais — tím vznikol v roku 1998 v Goiási a do Montes Claros sa presťahoval pred sezónou 2013/14; do Superligy 2026/27 postúpil ako finalista druhej ligy Superliga B.
nodes.desc_en: Montes Claros in the state of Minas Gerais — the team was founded in Goiás in 1998 and moved to Montes Claros before the 2013/14 season; it won promotion to the 2026/27 Superliga as runner-up of the second-tier Superliga B.

nodes.name: Norde Vôlei
nodes.desc: Fortaleza — klub založený v roku 2024 vyhral Superligu B 2025/26 a ako druhý tím zo štátu Ceará postúpil medzi elitu; vedie ho olympijský víťaz z Barcelony 1992 Marcelo Negrão. Vlastný web ani facebookovú stránku nemá, odkaz vedie na jeho oficiálny instagramový účet.
nodes.desc_en: Fortaleza — founded in 2024, the club won the 2025/26 Superliga B and became only the second team from the state of Ceará to reach the top flight; it is run by Barcelona 1992 Olympic champion Marcelo Negrão. It has neither a website nor a Facebook page, so the link goes to its official Instagram account.

nodes.name: Praia Clube
nodes.desc: Uberlândia — mužský tím viacšportového klubu skončil v základnej časti 2025/26 tretí; v Superlige hrá ako Praia Clube Uberlândia Vôlei. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú sekciu oficiálneho webu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Uberlândia — the multi-sport club’s men’s team finished third in the 2025/26 regular season; it plays in the Superliga as Praia Clube Uberlândia Vôlei. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Sada Cruzeiro
nodes.desc: Contagem pri Belo Horizonte — rekordný desaťnásobný majster Brazílie vrátane sezón 2024/25 a 2025/26, vo finále 2025/26 zdolal Vôlei Renata.
nodes.desc_en: Contagem near Belo Horizonte — record ten-time Brazilian champions, including 2024/25 and 2025/26, when they beat Vôlei Renata in the final.

nodes.name: Sesi Bauru
nodes.desc: Bauru — mužský tím SESI São Paulo, majster Brazílie 2010/11 a 2023/24, základnú časť 2025/26 skončil deviaty. Odkaz vedie na oficiálnu facebookovú stránku volejbalu SESI-SP.
nodes.desc_en: Bauru — the SESI São Paulo men’s team, Brazilian champions in 2010/11 and 2023/24, finished ninth in the 2025/26 regular season. The link goes to the official Facebook page of SESI-SP volleyball.

nodes.name: Suzano Vôlei
nodes.desc: Suzano v štáte São Paulo — základnú časť Superligy 2025/26 skončil piaty.
nodes.desc_en: Suzano in the state of São Paulo — the club finished fifth in the 2025/26 Superliga regular season.

nodes.name: Vôlei Guarulhos
nodes.desc: Guarulhos v štáte São Paulo — základnú časť 2025/26 skončil šiesty a jeho Bryan bol najlepším strelcom súťaže. Doména voleiguarulhos.com.br ukazuje len predvolenú stránku hostingu, odkaz preto vedie na oficiálny instagramový účet klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Guarulhos in the state of São Paulo — the club finished sixth in the 2025/26 regular season and its Bryan was the league’s top scorer. The voleiguarulhos.com.br domain shows only a hosting placeholder, so the link goes to the club’s official Instagram account.

nodes.name: Vôlei Renata
nodes.desc: Campinas — vicemajster Brazílie tri sezóny po sebe (2023/24, 2024/25, 2025/26), vo všetkých troch finále prehral.
nodes.desc_en: Campinas — Brazilian runners-up three seasons in a row (2023/24, 2024/25 and 2025/26), losing all three finals.

nodes.name: Vôlei São José
nodes.desc: São José dos Campos v štáte São Paulo — v sezóne 2026/27 hrá ako Viapol Vôlei São José, základnú časť 2025/26 skončil desiaty.
nodes.desc_en: São José dos Campos in the state of São Paulo — playing as Viapol Vôlei São José in 2026/27, the club finished tenth in the 2025/26 regular season.

nodes.name: Superliga žien

nodes.desc_en: Brazil’s top women’s volleyball competition, the Superliga — 12 clubs play the 2026/27 season, which starts on 17 October 2026. Praia Clube won the 2025/26 title, beating Minas in the final.

nodes.desc_en: Brusque in the state of Santa Catarina — playing in the Superliga as Abel Moda Vôlei, the club won the 2026 Superliga B, beating Pinheiros in the final, and returned to the top flight. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.desc_en: Barueri in the state of São Paulo — Barueri Volleyball Club plays in the Superliga in partnership with Club Athletico Paulistano as Paulistano Barueri, and were São Paulo state runners-up in 2025. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Brasília Vôlei

nodes.desc_en: Brasília — Brasília Vôlei Esporte Clube represents the Federal District; it fields a women’s team in the Superliga, while its men played in the second-tier Superliga B in 2025/26.

nodes.name: Fluminense
nodes.desc: Rio de Janeiro — dvojnásobný majster Brazílie (1976, 1981) z doby pred vznikom Superligy. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú sekciu oficiálneho webu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Rio de Janeiro — two-time Brazilian champions (1976, 1981) from the era before the Superliga. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Londrina

nodes.desc_en: Londrina in the state of Paraná — the AMAVOLEI team that played as Sancor Seguros Vôlei in Maringá moved to the Moringão arena in Londrina before the 2026/27 season. The link goes to the team’s official Instagram account.

nodes.name: Mackenzie

nodes.desc_en: Belo Horizonte — a club known for developing players, where two-time Olympic champion Sheilla Castro began her career; it plays in the Superliga as Batavo Mackenzie. The link goes to the official Instagram account of the women’s team.

nodes.name: Minas Tênis Clube

nodes.desc_en: Belo Horizonte — six-time Brazilian champions (most recently in 2023/24) and 2025/26 runners-up, playing as Gerdau Minas in 2026/27. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Osasco
nodes.desc: Osasco v štáte São Paulo — Osasco Voleibol Clube je šesťnásobný majster Brazílie (naposledy 2024/25), od sezóny 2021/22 hrá ako Osasco São Cristóvão Saúde.
nodes.desc_en: Osasco in the state of São Paulo — Osasco Voleibol Clube are six-time Brazilian champions (most recently in 2024/25) and have played as Osasco São Cristóvão Saúde since 2021/22.

nodes.name: Pinheiros

nodes.desc_en: São Paulo — the women’s team of the multi-sport Esporte Clube Pinheiros won promotion back to the top flight in 2026 as Superliga B runners-up. The club’s ecp.org.br website does not open from Europe, so the link goes to the volleyball section’s official Instagram account.

nodes.name: Praia Clube
nodes.desc: Uberlândia — majsterky Brazílie 2025/26, vo finále zdolali Minas a získali tretí titul (2017/18, 2022/23, 2025/26); v Superlige hrajú ako Dentil/Praia Clube. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú sekciu oficiálneho webu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Uberlândia — 2025/26 Brazilian champions, beating Minas in the final for their third title (2017/18, 2022/23, 2025/26); they play in the Superliga as Dentil/Praia Clube. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Sesc RJ Flamengo
nodes.desc: Rio de Janeiro — Rio de Janeiro Vôlei Clube je rekordný dvanásťnásobný majster Brazílie (naposledy 2016/17), od sezóny 2020/21 hrá v spolupráci s Flamengom a Sesc. Odkaz vedie na volejbalové správy na webe Flamenga.
nodes.desc_en: Rio de Janeiro — Rio de Janeiro Vôlei Clube are record twelve-time Brazilian champions (most recently in 2016/17) and have played in partnership with Flamengo and Sesc since 2020/21. The link goes to the volleyball news on Flamengo’s website.

nodes.name: Sesi Bauru
nodes.desc: Bauru — ženský tím Sesi Vôlei Bauru bol vicemajstrom Brazílie 2024/25. Odkaz vedie na oficiálnu facebookovú stránku tímu.
nodes.desc_en: Bauru — the Sesi Vôlei Bauru women’s team were Brazilian runners-up in 2024/25. The link goes to the team’s official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Superliga mužov

V priečinku je 10 klubov ročníka 2026/27 podľa zoznamu ACLAV (nováčikmi sú Ferro Carril Oeste a Sonder); titul 2025/26 získal UPCN San Juan Vóley.
nodes.desc_en: Argentina’s top men’s volleyball competition, run by ACLAV — from the 2026/27 season it is called Superliga Argentina de Voleibol, formerly Liga de Voleibol Argentina. The folder lists the 10 clubs of the 2026/27 season according to ACLAV (newcomers Ferro Carril Oeste and Sonder); the 2025/26 title went to UPCN San Juan Vóley.

Home games are played at the Gorki Grana arena in Morón. It has no website of its own, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires — Argentine champions in 1998/99, sixth in the 2025/26 season. The link goes to the volleyball page of the club’s website, shared by the men’s and women’s teams.

nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires, Boedo — the San Lorenzo de Almagro men’s team finished seventh in 2025/26. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: UPCN San Juan Vóley

nodes.desc_en: Comodoro Rivadavia in Chubut Province — the Patagonian club plays at the Estadio Socios Fundadores and finished ninth in 2025/26. The waiwenvoley.com domain listed on its Facebook page does not work, so the link goes to the club’s official Facebook page.

nodes.desc_en: Argentina’s top women’s volleyball competition, the Liga Argentina Femenina, run by the FeVA federation and played within a calendar year, from January to April. Boca Juniors won the 2026 edition; the folder lists the 15 clubs of the 2027 edition — the thirteen that stayed up in 2026 and two newcomers from the 2026 Liga Nacional.

nodes.desc_en: La Plata — the club finished fourteenth in the 2026 regular season and stayed up through the relegation round. The club’s Facebook page covers all its sections, so the link goes to the official volleyball Instagram account.

The club’s website has no volleyball page, so the link goes to the official Boca Juniors volleyball Instagram account, shared by the men’s and women’s teams.

nodes.name: Club Bell

nodes.desc_en: Bell Ville in Córdoba Province — Club Atlético y Biblioteca Bell returned to the Liga Argentina in 2026 and finished fourth in the regular season. The link goes to the volleyball news on the club’s website.

nodes.name: Ferro Carril Oeste
nodes.desc: Buenos Aires — v ročníku 2026 skončil v základnej časti ôsmy. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú rubriku oficiálneho webu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires — the club finished eighth in the 2026 regular season. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata
nodes.desc: La Plata — päťnásobná majsterka Argentíny (naposledy 2025), v roku 2026 vyhrala základnú časť a vo finále prehrala s Boca Juniors; klub bol v roku 1932 medzi zakladateľmi argentínskej volejbalovej federácie. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú sekciu oficiálneho webu klubu.
nodes.desc_en: La Plata — five-time Argentine champions (most recently in 2025); in 2026 they won the regular season and lost the final to Boca Juniors. The club was among the founders of the Argentine volleyball federation in 1932. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Glorias Argentinas

nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires, Mataderos — the club won the 2026 Liga Nacional unbeaten, beating Tucumán de Gimnasia 3–2 in the final to reach the 2027 Liga Argentina. Its Facebook page has been inactive since 2018, so the link goes to the volleyball section’s official Instagram account.

nodes.name: Instituto
nodes.desc: Córdoba — ženský tím Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba skončil v základnej časti 2026 jedenásty. Web klubu volejbalovú rubriku nemá a facebooková stránka ženského volejbalu je neaktívna od roku 2019, odkaz preto vedie na oficiálny instagramový účet volejbalového oddielu.
nodes.desc_en: Córdoba — the Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba women’s team finished eleventh in the 2026 regular season. The club’s website has no volleyball section and the women’s volleyball Facebook page has been inactive since 2019, so the link goes to the volleyball section’s official Instagram account.

nodes.name: River Plate

nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires — four-time Argentine champions (1998/99, 2004/05, 2005/06, 2006/07), tenth in the 2026 regular season. The link goes to the volleyball page of the club’s website, shared by the men’s and women’s teams.

nodes.name: San Isidro

nodes.desc_en: San Francisco in Córdoba Province — Club Atlético San Isidro won the 2025 Liga Nacional and reached the semi-finals in its first top-flight season in 2026. The volleyball section of the club’s website has not been updated since February 2025, so the link goes to the volleyball section’s official Instagram account.

nodes.desc_en: Buenos Aires, Boedo — Argentine champions in 2021, seventh in the 2026 regular season. The link goes to the volleyball section of the club’s official website.

nodes.name: Sonder

nodes.desc_en: Rosario — Club Sonder Rosario, a volleyball-focused club, finished second in the 2026 regular season and reached the semi-finals. The club only has an information page on the website of the clothing brand of the same name, so the link goes to its official Facebook page.

nodes.name: Tucumán de Gimnasia

nodes.desc_en: San Miguel de Tucumán — as runners-up of the 2026 Liga Nacional (a 2–3 defeat to Glorias Argentinas) the club was promoted to the 2027 Liga Argentina. The clubtucumandegimnasia.com domain does not work, so the link goes to the club’s official Facebook page, which covers both men’s and women’s volleyball.

nodes.name: Vélez Sarsfield
nodes.desc: Buenos Aires — majsterka Argentíny 2012/13, v roku 2026 skončila v základnej časti dvanásta. Odkaz vedie na volejbalovú sekciu oficiálneho webu klubu.

Prvý ročník 2026 liga oficiálne predstaví 28. septembra 2026 v Zinacantepecu; tímy Chihuahua a Gigantes de Aguascalientes sa z neho ešte pred začiatkom odhlásili.

The league will officially launch its first season, 2026, on 28 September 2026 in Zinacantepec; Chihuahua and Gigantes de Aguascalientes withdrew before the start.

nodes.name: Liga Superior žien
nodes.desc: Najvyššia bolívijská ženská volejbalová súťaž, ktorú organizuje Federación Boliviana de Voleibol. XXIX. ročník 2026 hralo prvýkrát osem klubov; titul získal San Martín pred Olympicom, San Simónom a Albertom Einsteinom. Olympic (La Paz) a América (Oruro) zostúpili, San Antonio Galas a Universitario sa zachránili. Zaradených je šesť klubov, ktoré v lige ostávajú; dvaja nováčikovia ročníka 2027 zatiaľ nie sú známi.
nodes.desc_en: Bolivia’s top women’s volleyball competition, organised by the Federación Boliviana de Voleibol. The 29th edition in 2026 was the first with eight clubs; San Martín took the title ahead of Olympic, San Simón and Albert Einstein. Olympic (La Paz) and América (Oruro) were relegated, while San Antonio Galas and Universitario stayed up. The six clubs remaining in the league are included; the two newcomers for 2027 are not yet known.

promos.name: Streamy
promos.title: Najviac športových streamov na Slovensku
promos.text:
Tipsport prevádzkuje najväčšiu športovú online televíziu u nás. Hokej, futbal, tenis, bojové športy — stovky živých prenosov domáceho aj svetového športu na jednom mieste, mnohé exkluzívne.
Streamy sú dostupné registrovaným hráčom bez ďalších poplatkov. Stačí účet a môžete sledovať aj tipovať naživo.

promos.name: Registrácia / bonus
promos.title: Bonus za registráciu u najväčšej stávkovej kancelárie
promos.text:
Tipsport je najväčšia a najdlhšie pôsobiaca stávková kancelária na Slovensku s licenciou Úradu pre reguláciu hazardných hier.
Nový hráč získa po registrácii uvítací bonus na prvé tipy. Registrácia trvá pár minút a overenie prebieha online.

promos.name: BetBuilder
promos.title: Vlastný tiket z jedného zápasu
promos.text:
BetBuilder umožňuje skombinovať viac príležitostí z jedného zápasu do jednej stávky — výsledok, počet gólov, strelca, karty.
Funguje aj naživo počas zápasu (BetBuilder Live), kurz kombinácie sa prepočíta okamžite.

promos.name: Live tipovanie
promos.title: Tipovanie naživo počas zápasu
promos.text:
Kurzy sa menia s každou minútou zápasu. V live ponuke Tipsportu nájdete tisíce udalostí denne — od Ligy majstrov po nižšie súťaže.
Live stávky sa dajú spojiť so streamom, takže zápas sledujete a tipujete v jednom okne.

promos.name: Tipsport liga 26/27 (sezónny)
promos.title: Slovenská extraliga nesie meno Tipsport
promos.text:
Najvyššia slovenská hokejová súťaž sa hrá ako Tipsport liga a všetky jej zápasy sú dostupné na streamoch Tipsportu — od úvodného buly po finále play-off.
K tomu česká Tipsport extraliga, Liga majstrov aj majstrovstvá sveta.
